description: A cardiac surgeon has pioneered a series of innovative solutions that have put health care within the reach of millions of people in India by harnessing state-of-the-art technology, top-flight talent, partnerships, and most of all creative leadership.
translatedDescription: Un cirujano cardíaco ha pionero una serie de soluciones innovadoras que han puesto la atención de la salud al alcance de millones de personas en la India aprovechando la tecnología de vanguardia, el talento de primer vuelo, las asociaciones y la mayoría de todos los liderazgos creativos.

title: Leadership in Action: Issues and Observations - Managing Talent is a Burning Issue in Asia
description: Talent management means understanding what the organization is going to need in terms of human resources far into the future.
translatedDescription: La gestión de talentos significa entender lo que la organización necesitará en términos de recursos humanos hasta el futuro.

title: Leadership in Action: Dividends and Interest - Crisis Brings a Yearning for Leadership
description: When the cameras were on the president, he was alone—and he delivered.
translatedDescription: Cuando las cámaras estaban en el presidente, estaba solo, y entregó.

title: Leadership in Action: The Smart People's Club: One Barrier to Leadership
description: The following strategies and action steps can be used to help a smart person improve his or her interpersonal behaviors.
translatedDescription: Las siguientes estrategias y pasos de acción se pueden utilizar para ayudar a una persona inteligente a mejorar sus comportamientos interpersonales.

title: Leadership in Action: Issues and Observations - Cultivating Teams
description: The leader needs to examine and create or develop appropriate structures and systems to support teamwork.
translatedDescription: El líder necesita examinar y crear o desarrollar estructuras y sistemas adecuados para apoyar el trabajo en equipo.

title: Leadership in Action: Beyond the Bottom Line: Practicing Leadership for Sustainability
description: Here's a primer for leaders on how to approach sustainability.
translatedDescription: Aquí hay una imprenta para los líderes sobre cómo abordar la sostenibilidad.

title: Leadership in Action: Leadership Briefing - The Importance of Subordinate Feedback
description: Leaders need to create environments in which obstacles to feedback from subordinates are removed.
translatedDescription: Los líderes necesitan crear entornos en los que se eliminan los obstáculos a la retroalimentación de los subordinados.

title: Leadership in Action: Dividends and Interest - Book Choices Speak Volumes
description: Reading can be an important supplement to our real-world experiences.
translatedDescription: La lectura puede ser un suplemento importante para nuestras experiencias del mundo real.

title: From Crisis to Coopetition: What Leaders Can Learn From Anesthesiologists
description: The playbook from a crisis in credibility for anesthesiologists offers many lessons for business leaders. One key: With coopetition, organizations can sometimes achieve more together than they could on their own. Explore five practices from the anesthesiologists’ coopetition playbook that could help your industry: Study failures collectively, create neutral ground for rivals, set shared standards, ensure interoperability, and pool resources strategically.
translatedDescription: El libro de juegos de una crisis de credibilidad para los anestesiólogos ofrece muchas lecciones para los líderes empresariales. Una clave: Con la coopetición, las organizaciones a veces pueden lograr más juntos de lo que podrían por sí mismas. Explore cinco prácticas del libro de la coopetición de los anestesiólogos que podrían ayudar a su industria: Las fallas de estudio colectivamente crean un terreno neutral para los rivales, establecen normas compartidas, aseguran la interoperabilidad y los recursos de la piscina estratégicamente.

title: Dismissing an Employee
description: While no one likes to be the bearer of bad news, managers are sometimes faced with the difficult task of having to dismiss an employee. In this book, you'll learn how to effectively manage a dismissal--including making key decisions before, during, and after the critical event. Handled skillfully, dismissing an employee can set your team--and your company--on a positive new path.
translatedDescription: Aunque a nadie le gusta ser el portador de malas noticias, los gerentes a veces se enfrentan a la difícil tarea de tener que despedir a un empleado. En este libro, usted aprenderá a manejar eficazmente un despido, incluyendo tomar decisiones clave antes, durante y después del evento crítico. Manejado hábilmente, despedir a un empleado puede establecer su equipo, y su empresa, en un nuevo camino positivo.

title: An Introduction to Lean Work Design
description: This book provides a short, concise overview of lean work design, which sees lean systems as the result of a systematic implementation of appropriate work processes. It discusses lean tools, but views tools only as a means of achieving a desirable work design and does not see the use of lean tools as a goal in themselves.
translatedDescription: Este libro ofrece una breve y concisa visión general del diseño de trabajo magro, que considera sistemas magros como resultado de una implementación sistemática de procesos de trabajo apropiados. Habla de herramientas magras, pero ve las herramientas sólo como un medio para lograr un diseño de trabajo deseable y no ve el uso de herramientas magras como un objetivo en sí mismos.

title: Lead Self First Before Leading Others
description: At the core of exceptional leadership is the ability to lead self. Some level of proficiency can be demonstrated by simply focusing on leading others. But to achieve transformational results, leading self is essential. Cultivating self-awareness and developing a life plan are key elements of leading self. And really, should not leaders demonstrate a level of self-mastery before leading others? It is time that leaders move to a deeper understanding of themselves as they operate within a world of accelerated change and increasing complexity. Although leadership performance is evidenced in outward results, decisions, and actions, the genesis of the leadership performance is an internal endeavor. Resiliency and ethical behavior are grounded by having a strong sense of purpose, established vision, and clear operating values. To the degree that the leader is consciously leading self, the quality of his or her leadership corresponds. Be it for good or evil, conscious leadership is powerful. This book makes plain the case for enhanced self-awareness, provides case studies and research support, presents the voices of several master leadership coaches, and most importantly…leads the reader through the life planning process.
translatedDescription: En el núcleo de un liderazgo excepcional es la capacidad de liderarse. Se puede demostrar cierto nivel de competencia simplemente centrándose en liderar a otros. Pero para lograr resultados transformadores, el ser líder es esencial. Cultivar la conciencia de sí mismo y desarrollar un plan de vida son elementos clave de uno mismo líder. Y en realidad, ¿no deberían los líderes demostrar un nivel de autodominio antes de liderar a otros? Es hora de que los líderes avancen hacia una comprensión más profunda de sí mismos mientras operan dentro de un mundo de cambio acelerado y complejidad creciente. Aunque el desempeño del liderazgo se evidencia en resultados externos, decisiones y acciones, la génesis del desempeño del liderazgo es un esfuerzo interno. La resiliencia y el comportamiento ético se basan en tener un fuerte sentido de propósito, visión establecida y valores operativos claros. En la medida en que el líder sea conscientemente líder, la calidad de su liderazgo corresponde. Sea para el bien o el mal, el liderazgo consciente es poderoso. Este libro deja claro el caso de una mayor conciencia de sí mismo, proporciona estudios de casos y soporte de investigación, presenta las voces de varios entrenadores de liderazgo maestro, y lo más importante... da lectura al lector a través del proceso de planificación de la vida.

title: Videoconferencing for the Real World
description:
"John Rhodes' Videoconferencing for the Real World, is a one of the world's most comprehensive blueprints on the awesome power of videoconferencing."
From the Foreword by Brad Caldwell
Chairman ICIA and President of
Integrated Media Services, Anaheim, CA

Designed to be useful to both technical and non-technical managers, Video-Conferencing for the Real World demystifies the subject of video communications. It provides easy-to-follow guidelines for deploying a cost-effective video-conferencing solution tailored to an organization's specific needs.

Developed to flexible to the readers need, Video Conferencing for the Real World offers dynamic problem-solving techniques for the communication challenges facing managers today. Examining the technical, economic, and organizational aspects of each requirement and solution, this book offers a sound base of technical information and provides practical solutions based on a wealth of professional experience. Combining his own ideas with the input of system managers and users, service providers, consultants, and manufacturers, the author has developed a guide that will help readers make more informed investments of their time and money. Special attention is paid to conducting an effective needs analysis, and the development of solutions that will adapt easily to future changes in organizational requirements.

Covering a variety of solutions, this book explores the advantages and disadvantages of desktop systems, set-top systems, rollabout systems, and room systems. In addition to compression, multipoint conferencing and data conferencing, this book also addresses topics such as, pilot projects, the preparation of RFPs, service contracts, training, content creation, and convergence.
translatedDescription:
"La videoconferencia de John Rhodes para el Mundo Real, es uno de los planos más completos del mundo sobre el increíble poder de videoconferencia".
De la prólogo de Brad Caldwell
Presidente ICIA y Presidente
Integrated Media Services, Anaheim, CA

Diseñado para ser útil tanto para gerentes técnicos como no técnicos, Videoconferencia para el Mundo Real desmitifica el tema de las comunicaciones de vídeo. Proporciona directrices fáciles de seguir para implementar una solución de videoconferencias rentable adaptada a las necesidades específicas de una organización.

Desarrollado para ser flexible para los lectores, Video Conferencing for the Real World ofrece técnicas dinámicas de solución de problemas para los desafíos de comunicación que enfrentan hoy los administradores. Examinando los aspectos técnicos, económicos y organizativos de cada requisito y solución, este libro ofrece una base sólida de información técnica y ofrece soluciones prácticas basadas en una gran experiencia profesional. Combinando sus propias ideas con la entrada de administradores de sistemas y usuarios, proveedores de servicios, consultores y fabricantes, el autor ha desarrollado una guía que ayudará a los lectores a hacer inversiones más informadas de su tiempo y dinero. Se presta especial atención a la realización de un análisis eficaz de las necesidades y al desarrollo de soluciones que se adapten fácilmente a los cambios futuros en las necesidades de organización.

Cubrir una variedad de soluciones, este libro explora las ventajas y desventajas de los sistemas de escritorio, los sistemas de configuración, los sistemas de rodadura y los sistemas de habitaciones. Además de compresión, conferencias multipuntos y conferencias de datos, este libro también aborda temas como, proyectos piloto, la preparación de RFPs, contratos de servicio, capacitación, creación de contenidos y convergencia.

title: Co-Design, Volume III
description:
Working in complex systems brings fresh challenges to leaders, managers, consultants, and those involved in their education. This book (the third in a series of three) introduces a set of practices that will help you develop confidence and strength in working in new ways across boundaries. We know intuitively that when we move outside our organizational boundaries, we need new ways of practicing that will respond to the needs of others and shape the emerging future. Each chapter focuses on a specific practice and explains what it looks like, why it is relevant, and how to integrate it into your work.

Questions for reflection and suggested activities offer ideas for immediate action. The format invites the reader to pick a chapter or two when it feels like a good time to engage with professional development. The material is also suitable for discussion with colleagues as part of team development. The practical, applied nature of this book means that it can be used in many different ways to spark ideas and stimulate new ways of working as individuals and collectively. Leaders in complex systems will grow in confidence and expand their practice repertoire as they engage with the material in this volume.
translatedDescription:
Trabajar en sistemas complejos trae nuevos desafíos a los líderes, gerentes, consultores, y a los involucrados en su educación. Este libro (el tercero de una serie de tres) introduce un conjunto de prácticas que le ayudarán a desarrollar confianza y fuerza en el trabajo de nuevas maneras a través de los límites. Sabemos intuitivamente que cuando nos movemos fuera de nuestros límites organizativos, necesitamos nuevas formas de practicar que respondan a las necesidades de otros y configuran el futuro emergente. Cada capítulo se centra en una práctica específica y explica cómo se ve, por qué es relevante y cómo integrarla en su trabajo.

Preguntas para la reflexión y actividades sugeridas ofrecen ideas para la acción inmediata. El formato invita al lector a elegir un capítulo o dos cuando se siente como un buen momento para interactuar con el desarrollo profesional. El material también es adecuado para el debate con colegas como parte del desarrollo de equipo. La naturaleza práctica y aplicada de este libro significa que puede utilizarse de muchas maneras diferentes para suscitar ideas y estimular nuevas formas de trabajar como individuos y colectivamente. Los líderes en sistemas complejos crecerán en confianza y expandirán su repertorio práctica mientras se involucran con el material en este volumen.

title: Leadership Through A Screen
description:
The book defines and helps provide key solutions for some of the greatest leadership challenges facing global managers today.

Leadership Through the Screen is a business leadership guidebook that tells a story. Written in an easy-to-read manner, each chapter highlights a single issue through the eyes of a fictional VP of marketing. The authors have done the research and included it in these pages so that business leaders do not have to.

This book is meant to serve as a map to help modern managers weave their way through many of the fundamental challenges of leading people in a global and virtual realm. It provides the tools, knowledge, and potential solutions these leaders can use to forge successful and productive virtual teams.
translatedDescription:
El libro define y ayuda a proporcionar soluciones clave para algunos de los mayores desafíos de liderazgo que enfrentan hoy los administradores globales.

Dirección A través de la Pantalla es una guía de liderazgo empresarial que cuenta una historia. Escrito de manera fácil de leer, cada capítulo destaca un solo problema a través de los ojos de un vicepresidente ficticio de marketing. Los autores han realizado la investigación y la han incluido en estas páginas para que los líderes empresariales no tengan que hacerlo.

Este libro está destinado a servir como un mapa para ayudar a los administradores modernos a tejer su camino a través de muchos de los desafíos fundamentales de dirigir a la gente en un reino global y virtual. Proporciona las herramientas, el conocimiento y las posibles soluciones que estos líderes pueden utilizar para forjar equipos virtuales exitosos y productivos.

title: The Essential Guide to Employee Engagement
description: The Essential Guide to Employee Engagement explores how managers can engage their staff to become more productive, engender greater levels of customer satisfaction, drive organizational success and retain talented employees.
translatedDescription: La Guía Esencial para la Participación de los Empleados explora cómo los directivos pueden comprometer a su personal a ser más productivos, engendrar mayores niveles de satisfacción del cliente, impulsar el éxito organizativo y retener empleados talentosos.

title: Leadership in Action: Reader Forum - Leadership Lessons from a Whaleboat
description: The whaleboat is a wonderful metaphor for any organization that must progress and adjust in the open seas of uncertain markets.
translatedDescription: La lancha es una maravillosa metáfora para cualquier organización que debe progresar y ajustarse en el mar abierto de mercados inciertos.

title: Leadership in Action: Through a New Lens: A Talk with Margaret J. Wheatley
description: Margaret J. Wheatley writes, teaches, and speaks about radically new ideas for organizing and leading in chaotic times. CCL president John Alexander interviewed Wheatley during the third annual Friends of the Center Leadership Conference in Kansas City, Missouri.
translatedDescription: Margaret J. Wheatley escribe, enseña y habla de ideas radicalmente nuevas para organizar y dirigir en tiempos caóticos. El presidente de la CCL John Alexander entrevistó a Wheatley durante la tercera Conferencia anual de Amigos del Centro de Liderazgo en Kansas City, Missouri.

title: Leadership in Action: Conversation Piece: Using Dialogue as a Tool for Better Leadership
description: In times of chaos and complexity, organizations become increasingly fragmented. One way to introduce connection, awareness and appreciation of similarities and differences, and cultivation of shared understandings to the leadership of organizations is through dialogue. Here are some principles that groups can follow in using dialogue to help them steer their way through new and uncertain environments.
translatedDescription: En tiempos de caos y complejidad, las organizaciones se fragmentan cada vez más. Una manera de establecer la conexión, la conciencia y el reconocimiento de similitudes y diferencias, y el cultivo de entendimientos compartidos a los dirigentes de las organizaciones es mediante el diálogo. Estos son algunos principios que los grupos pueden seguir utilizando el diálogo para ayudarlos a guiar su camino a través de entornos nuevos e inciertos.

title: Leadership in Action: Dividends and interest—The Last Leadership Guru
description: Everyone is an expert on leadership. Each one of us, every day, is deeply involved in its practice. At work, at home, and in our various communities—anytime there is a situation to be evaluated and a decision to be made and followed up on—we are participating in leadership.
translatedDescription: Todo el mundo es un experto en liderazgo. Cada uno de nosotros, cada día, está profundamente involucrado en su práctica. En el trabajo, en casa y en nuestras diversas comunidades —cuando hay una situación que evaluar y una decisión a tomar y seguir— estamos participando en el liderazgo.

title: Leadership in Action: Reader Forum - Achieving Results Through Joy
description: Many companies are beginning to understand that when their employees are happy, when they experience joy, they are also more productive.
translatedDescription: Muchas empresas están empezando a entender que cuando sus empleados son felices, cuando experimentan alegría, también son más productivos.

title: Leadership in Action: Reader Forum - Joseph and His Amazing Leadership Lesson
description: The story of Joseph and his holistic approach provides the basis for a new culture of leadership based on morality, stewardship, and community.
translatedDescription: La historia de José y su enfoque holístico proporciona la base para una nueva cultura de liderazgo basada en la moral, la administración y la comunidad.

title: Leadership in Action: Issues and Observations - Making Leadership a Reality
description: This article is the text of a graduation speech that Harriet Fulbright gave on May 23, 2006, at the Early College of Guilford, an advanced-placement public high school in Greensboro, North Carolina.
translatedDescription: Este artículo es el texto de un discurso de graduación que Harriet Fulbright dio el 23 de mayo de 2006, en el Early College of Guilford, una escuela pública avanzada en Greensboro, Carolina del Norte.

title: Leadership Development’s Epic Fail
description: As busy as they are, leaders need to find ways to observe fundamental work processes in their organizations. When they do, they usually discover that there are gaps between theory and reality in how works get done. Michael Morales’ experience — in which identifying and addressing such gaps led to his company saving $50,000 in just 60 days — is a case in point.
translatedDescription: Tan ocupados como están, los líderes necesitan encontrar maneras de observar procesos de trabajo fundamentales en sus organizaciones. Cuando lo hacen, suelen descubrir que hay brechas entre la teoría y la realidad en cómo se hacen los trabajos. La experiencia de Michael Morales —en la que identificar y abordar tales brechas llevó a su empresa a ahorrar $50.000 en tan solo 60 días— es un caso en cuestión.

title: Leadership in Action: Across the Boards - How Chairmen's Roles Differ Around the World
description: Recent research has found that practices of chairmanship and board dynamics differ around the world. What are the implications for organizations in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia?
translatedDescription: Investigaciones recientes han encontrado que las prácticas de presidencia y dinámicas de juntas difieren en todo el mundo. ¿Cuáles son las consecuencias para las organizaciones de los Estados Unidos, el Reino Unido y Australia?

title: Leadership in Action: Follow-Up - A Valuable Tool in Leadership Development
description: People can be motivated by charting a leadership development path and looking forward to periodic measures to indicate their progress.
translatedDescription: Las personas pueden estar motivadas por trazar un camino de desarrollo de liderazgo y esperando medidas periódicas para indicar su progreso.

title: Leadership in Action: Out in the Open: How Team Leaders Can Deal with Sensitive Issues
description: A wide range of sensitive issues can emerge in a team environment, and the range of causes can be equally wide. Such issues can threaten a team's viability and the quality of the final work product. Team leaders may need to intervene when such situations develop, and once they have decided to intervene, they need to know how best to do so.
translatedDescription: Una amplia gama de cuestiones sensibles puede surgir en un entorno de equipo, y la gama de causas puede ser igualmente amplia. Tales problemas pueden amenazar la viabilidad de un equipo y la calidad del producto final del trabajo. Los líderes del equipo tal vez necesiten intervenir cuando esas situaciones se desarrollan, y una vez que han decidido intervenir, necesitan saber lo mejor que pueden hacer.

title: Leadership in Action: Experience Counts: Learning Lessons from Key Events
description: How can leaders help their groups learn lessons—whether positive or negative—from key events? A process that CCL calls critical reflections begins with a key event and is followed by three stages: exploring, reflecting, and projecting. The goal is to create a specific action plan that will set the stage for a productive future
translatedDescription: ¿Cómo pueden los líderes ayudar a sus grupos a aprender lecciones —ya sean positivas o negativas— de acontecimientos clave? Un proceso que CCL llama reflexiones críticas comienza con un evento clave y sigue tres etapas: explorar, reflexionar y proyectar. El objetivo es crear un plan de acción específico que establezca el escenario para un futuro productivo

title: Leadership in Action: In Focus - Lessons of Experience—Chinese leaders Tackle Global Challenges
description: We interviewed two Chinese leaders, asking them about the experiences that have helped them develop as leaders, their strategies for meeting their organizations' new challenges, and their approaches to motivating and empowering their employees.
translatedDescription: Entrevistamos a dos líderes chinos, preguntándoles sobre las experiencias que les han ayudado a desarrollarse como líderes, sus estrategias para enfrentar los nuevos retos de sus organizaciones, y sus enfoques para motivar y empoderar a sus empleados.

title: Leadership in Action: Issues and Observations - Leadership Lessons from a Scrapbook
description: Leadership demands inspiring a shared vision, encouraging the heart, and motivating those who need.
translatedDescription: El liderazgo exige inspirar una visión compartida, alentar el corazón y motivar a los que necesitan.

title: Leadership in Action: Issues and Observations - In Organizations, It Takes All Kinds
description: The most encouraging news is that research has shown that no matter whether one leans toward managing, leading, or neither, both sets of skills can be learned with effort and over time.
translatedDescription: La noticia más alentadora es que la investigación ha demostrado que no importa si uno se inclina hacia la gestión, dirección o ninguno de los dos conjuntos de habilidades se puede aprender con esfuerzo y con el tiempo.

title: Leadership in Action: Redefining Accountability - A Talk with Peter Block
description: Author, consultant, and speaker Peter Block believes that to become truly service driven, organizations must move beyond efforts that produce only cosmetic change and instead must create accountability at all levels by placing control close to the core work.
translatedDescription: Autor, consultor y orador Peter Block cree que para llegar a ser realmente impulsado por el servicio, las organizaciones deben ir más allá de los esfuerzos que producen sólo cambio cosmético y en cambio deben crear rendición de cuentas en todos los niveles colocando el control cerca del trabajo básico.

title: How Linux Works, 3rd Edition
description:
Unlike some operating systems, Linux doesn’t try to hide the important bits from you—it gives you full control of your computer. But to truly master Linux, you need to understand its internals, like how the system boots, how networking works, and what the kernel actually does.

In this third edition of the bestselling How Linux Works, author Brian Ward peels back the layers of this well-loved operating system to make Linux internals accessible. This edition has been thoroughly updated and expanded with added coverage of Logical Volume Manager (LVM), virtualization, and containers.

You'll learn:

•How Linux boots, from boot loaders to init (systemd)•How the kernel manages devices, device drivers, and processes•How networking, interfaces, firewalls, and servers work•How development tools work and relate to shared libraries•How to write effective shell scripts

You’ll also explore the kernel and examine key system tasks inside user space, including system calls, input and output, and filesystems. With its combination of background, theory, real-world examples, and patient explanations, How Linux Works, 3rd edition will teach you what you need to know to solve pesky problems and take control of your operating system.
translatedDescription:
A diferencia de algunos sistemas operativos, Linux no trata de ocultar los bits importantes de usted, le da el control completo de su computadora. Pero para realmente dominar Linux, usted necesita entender sus internos, como cómo arranca el sistema, cómo funciona el networking, y lo que realmente hace el núcleo.

En esta tercera edición del bestselling How Linux Works, el autor Brian Ward hace retroceder las capas de este sistema operativo bien querido para que los internos de Linux sean accesibles. Esta edición ha sido completamente actualizada y ampliada con una cobertura adicional del Administrador de Volumen Logical (LVM), virtualización y contenedores.

Aprenderás:

•Cómo arranca Linux, desde cargadores de arranque hasta init (sistemad) • Cómo el núcleo administra dispositivos, controladores de dispositivo y procesos• Cómo funcionan las redes, interfaces, cortafuegos y servidores• Cómo funcionan las herramientas de desarrollo y se relacionan con las bibliotecas compartidas• Cómo escribir scripts de shell eficaces

También explorará el núcleo y examinará las tareas clave del sistema dentro del espacio de usuario, incluyendo llamadas del sistema, entrada y salida, y sistemas de archivos. Con su combinación de antecedentes, teoría, ejemplos del mundo real y explicaciones de los pacientes, Cómo funciona Linux, tercera edición le enseñará lo que necesita saber para resolver problemas de pesky y tomar el control de su sistema operativo.

title: System Programming in Linux
description:
Most programmers never learn how Linux really works. Why? Because system programming is rarely taught, and the tools can be intimidating without the right guidance. As a result, many developers stick to high-level languages and frameworks—writing code that runs on Linux without understanding how it interacts with Linux.

In today’s world, that’s not enough to stand out. Especially as more companies turn to AI to write their software, the question becomes: How do you stay relevant in an AI-driven world? You learn how things really work.

If you’ve ever wondered how processes are created, how memory and files are managed, or how programs communicate in a Unix environment, System Programming in Linux will make it all make sense.

This is a hands-on guide to writing software that interfaces directly with the Linux operating system. You’ll go beyond shell commands and abstractions to understand what the kernel is doing—and how to leverage it through your own code. Rather than telling you how to solve each problem, Professor Stewart N. Weiss guides you through the process of discovering the solution yourself.

Start with the core concepts of Unix and Linux, then work your way up to advanced topics like process control, signals, interprocess communication, threading, and non-blocking I/O. Each chapter includes conceptual diagrams, annotated source code, and practical projects to help you immediately apply what you’ve learned.

You’ll explore topics such as:

The structure of Unix and Linux operating systems—and why it matters
Using system calls to create and manage processes
The mechanics of signals, timers, and interprocess communication
Using synchronization tools to write multithreaded programs
Interacting with filesystems, devices, and terminals
Building text-based user interfaces using ncurses
Developing programs that are robust, efficient, and portable

At Hunter College, Professor Weiss built the course this book is based on, and he has helped thousands of students go from confusion to confidence in his over 40 years of teaching programming. His clear, conversational style; technical depth; and focus on real-world application make this one of the most approachable and powerful system programming books available.

As Linux continues to dominate development, server, and embedded environments, understanding the system behind your software isn’t just helpful; it’s essential.

Whether you’re a student, developer, or sysadmin, this book gives you the tools to work directly with Linux and the insight to understand what’s really happening under the hood.
translatedDescription:
La mayoría de los programadores nunca aprenden cómo funciona Linux realmente. ¿Por qué? Debido a que la programación del sistema rara vez se enseña, y las herramientas pueden ser intimidantes sin la orientación correcta. Como resultado, muchos desarrolladores se adhieren a idiomas y marcos de alto nivel: código de escritura que funciona en Linux sin entender cómo interactúa con Linux.

En el mundo de hoy, eso no es suficiente para destacar. Especialmente cuando más empresas recurren a AI para escribir su software, la pregunta se convierte en: ¿Cómo se mantiene relevante en un mundo impulsado por IA? Aprendes cómo funcionan las cosas.

Si alguna vez se ha preguntado cómo se crean los procesos, cómo se gestiona la memoria y los archivos, o cómo se comunican los programas en un entorno Unix, Programación de sistema en Linux hará que todo tenga sentido.

Esta es una guía práctica para escribir software que interfiere directamente con el sistema operativo Linux. Usted irá más allá de los comandos de shell y abstracciones para entender lo que el núcleo está haciendo, y cómo aprovecharlo a través de su propio código. En lugar de decirle cómo resolver cada problema, el profesor Stewart N. Weiss le guía a través del proceso de descubrir la solución usted mismo.

Comience con los conceptos básicos de Unix y Linux, luego trabaje hasta temas avanzados como control de procesos, señales, comunicación interproceso, rosca y no bloqueo I/O. Cada capítulo incluye diagramas conceptuales, código fuente anotado y proyectos prácticos para ayudarle a aplicar inmediatamente lo que ha aprendido.

Explorará temas como:

La estructura de los sistemas operativos Unix y Linux, y por qué importa
Usar llamadas de sistema para crear y gestionar procesos
Los mecánicos de señales, temporizadores y comunicación interprocesal
Utilizando herramientas de sincronización para escribir programas multiteleados
Interactuación con sistemas de archivos, dispositivos y terminales
Construcción de interfaces de usuario basadas en texto utilizando ncurses
Desarrollo de programas robustos, eficientes y portátiles

En Hunter College, el profesor Weiss construyó el curso en el que se basa este libro, y ha ayudado a miles de estudiantes a pasar de la confusión a la confianza en sus más de 40 años de programación docente. Su estilo claro y conversacional; profundidad técnica; y enfoque en la aplicación del mundo real hacen que este uno de los libros de programación del sistema más accesibles y poderosos disponibles.

Como Linux sigue dominando el desarrollo, el servidor y los entornos incrustados, entender el sistema detrás de su software no es sólo útil; es esencial.

Ya sea estudiante, desarrollador o sysadmin, este libro le da las herramientas para trabajar directamente con Linux y la información para entender lo que está sucediendo realmente bajo la capucha.

title: The Linux Programming Interface
description:
The Linux Programming Interface is the definitive guide to the Linux and UNIX programming interface—the interface employed by nearly every application that runs on a Linux or UNIX system.

In this authoritative work, Linux programming expert Michael Kerrisk provides detailed descriptions of the system calls and library functions that you need in order to master the craft of system programming, and accompanies his explanations with clear, complete example programs.

You'll find descriptions of over 500 system calls and library functions, and more than 200 example programs, 88 tables, and 115 diagrams. You'll learn how to:

Read and write files efficiently
Use signals, clocks, and timers
Create processes and execute programs
Write secure programs
Write multithreaded programs using POSIX threads
Build and use shared libraries
Perform interprocess communication using pipes, message queues, shared memory, and semaphores
Write network applications with the sockets API

While The Linux Programming Interface covers a wealth of Linux-specific features, including epoll, inotify, and the /proc file system, its emphasis on UNIX standards (POSIX.1-2001/SUSv3 and POSIX.1-2008/SUSv4) makes it equally valuable to programmers working on other UNIX platforms.

The Linux Programming Interface is the most comprehensive single-volume work on the Linux and UNIX programming interface, and a book that's destined to become a new classic.

Praise for The Linux Programming Interface "If I had to choose a single book to sit next to my machine when writing software for Linux, this would be it." Martin Landers, Software Engineer, Google "This book, with its detailed descriptions and examples, contains everything you need to understand the details and nuances of the low-level programming APIs in Linux . . . no matter what the level of reader, there will be something to be learnt from this book." Mel Gorman, Author of Understanding the Linux Virtual Memory Manager "Michael Kerrisk has not only written a great book about Linux programming and how it relates to various standards, but has also taken care that bugs he noticed got fixed and the man pages were (greatly) improved. In all three ways, he has made Linux programming easier. The in-depth treatment of topics in The Linux Programming Interface . . . makes it a must-have reference for both new and experienced Linux programmers." Andreas Jaeger, Program Manager, openSUSE, Novell "Michael's inexhaustible determination to get his information right, and to express it clearly and concisely, has resulted in a strong reference source for programmers. While this work is targeted at Linux programmers, it will be of value to any programmer working in the UNIX/POSIX ecosystem." David Butenhof, Author of Programming with POSIX Threads and Contributor to the POSIX and UNIX Standards ". . . a very thorough—yet easy to read—explanation of UNIX system and network programming, with an emphasis on Linux systems. It's certainly a book I'd recommend to anybody wanting to get into UNIX programming (in general) or to experienced UNIX programmers wanting to know 'what's new' in the popular GNU/Linux system." Fernando Gont, Network Security Researcher, IETF Participant, and RFC Author ". . . encyclopedic in the breadth and depth of its coverage, and textbook-like in its wealth of worked examples and exercises. Each topic is clearly and comprehensively covered, from theory to hands-on working code. Professionals, students, educators, this is the Linux/UNIX reference that you have been waiting for." Anthony Robins, Associate Professor of Computer Science, The University of Otago "I've been very impressed by the precision, the quality and the level of detail Michael Kerrisk put in his book. He is a great expert of Linux system calls and lets us share his knowledge and understanding of the Linux APIs." Christophe Blaess, Author of Programmation systeme en C sous Linux ". . . an essential resource for the serious or professional Linux and UNIX systems programmer. Michael Kerrisk covers the use of all the key APIs across both the Linux and UNIX system interfaces with clear descriptions and tutorial examples and stresses the importance and benefits of following standards such as the Single UNIX Specification and POSIX 1003.1." Andrew Josey, Director, Standards, The Open Group, and Chair of the POSIX 1003.1 Working Group "What could be better than an encyclopedic reference to the Linux system, from the standpoint of the system programmer, written by none other than the maintainer of the man pages himself? The Linux Programming Interface is comprehensive and detailed. I firmly expect it to become an indispensable addition to my programming bookshelf." Bill Gallmeister, Author of POSIX.4 Programmer's Guide: Programming for the Real World ". . . the most complete and up-to-date book about Linux and UNIX system programming. If you're new to Linux system programming, if you're a UNIX veteran focused on portability while interested in learning the Linux way, or if you're simply looking for an excellent reference about the Linux programming interface, then Michael Kerrisk's book is definitely the companion you want on your bookshelf." Loic Domaigne, Chief Software Architect (Embedded), Corpuls.com

Profesionales, estudiantes, educadores, esta es la referencia Linux/UNIX que ha estado esperando." Anthony Robins, profesor asociado de informática, Universidad de Otago "He estado muy impresionado por la precisión, la calidad y el nivel de detalle que Michael Kerrisk puso en su libro. title: The Linux Command Line, 3rd Edition
description:
The Linux Command Line isn’t just a reference manual. It’s a complete education on how Linux really works. From your first tentative keystrokes to writing powerful shell scripts, you’ll build the confidence and understanding to make your system work for you.

Now in its third edition, this best-selling guide has been fully updated with modern examples, nearly 40 pages of new content, and downloadable scripts from LinuxCommand.org. Used in more than a thousand classrooms and libraries worldwide, it has helped over 150,000 readers gain fluency and confidence in Linux.

Author and command line guru William Shotts delivers not just commands, but genuine insight, guided by his philosophy: Make everything as simple as possible, but no simpler.

Through short, digestible chapters, you’ll learn to:

Navigate the filesystem, manage files, and configure your environment
Chain commands, redirect input/output, and use regular expressions
Control processes, manage packages, and work with networking tools
Edit files with Vim
Write shell scripts to automate tasks and build custom tools
Use core utilities like grep, cut, sed, and tar to process data
Manage filesystems and compile programs from source

Whether you’re managing servers, studying cybersecurity, or just curious about your computer, The Linux Command Line gives you the knowledge to command your system with confidence.

title: Practical Linear Algebra for Data Science
description:
If you want to work in any computational or technical field, you need to understand linear algebra. As the study of matrices and operations acting upon them, linear algebra is the mathematical basis of nearly all algorithms and analyses implemented in computers. But the way it's presented in decades-old textbooks is much different from how professionals use linear algebra today to solve real-world modern applications.

This practical guide from Mike X Cohen teaches the core concepts of linear algebra as implemented in Python, including how they're used in data science, machine learning, deep learning, computational simulations, and biomedical data processing applications. Armed with knowledge from this book, you'll be able to understand, implement, and adapt myriad modern analysis methods and algorithms.

Ideal for practitioners and students using computer technology and algorithms, this book introduces you to:

The interpretations and applications of vectors and matrices
Matrix arithmetic (various multiplications and transformations)
Independence, rank, and inverses
Important decompositions used in applied linear algebra (including LU and QR)
Eigendecomposition and singular value decomposition
Applications including least-squares model fitting and principal components analysis
translatedDescription:
Si quieres trabajar en cualquier campo computacional o técnico, necesitas entender álgebra lineal. Como estudio de matrices y operaciones que actúan sobre ellos, el álgebra lineal es la base matemática de casi todos los algoritmos y análisis implementados en las computadoras. Pero la forma en que se presenta en libros de texto de décadas es muy diferente de cómo los profesionales utilizan álgebra lineal hoy para resolver aplicaciones modernas del mundo real.

Esta guía práctica de Mike X Cohen enseña los conceptos básicos del álgebra lineal como implementado en Python, incluyendo cómo se utilizan en la ciencia de datos, el aprendizaje automático, el aprendizaje profundo, simulaciones computacionales y aplicaciones de procesamiento de datos biomédicos. Armado con conocimiento de este libro, podrás comprender, implementar y adaptar métodos y algoritmos de análisis modernos.

Ideal para practicantes y estudiantes usando tecnología informática y algoritmos, este libro le presenta:

Las interpretaciones y aplicaciones de vectores y matrices
Matriz aritmética (varios multiplicaciones y transformaciones)
Independencia, rango e inversos
Descomposiciones importantes utilizadas en álgebra lineal aplicada (incluyendo LU y QR)
Eigendecomposición y descomposición de valor singular
Aplicaciones incluyendo el ajuste de modelos de menor calidad y el análisis de componentes principales

title: Learning Modern Linux
description:
If you use Linux in development or operations and need a structured approach to help you dive deeper, this book is for you. Author Michael Hausenblas also provides tips and tricks for improving your workflow with this open source operating system. Whether you're a developer, software architect, or site reliability engineer, this hands-on guide focuses on ways to use Linux for your everyday needs, from development to office-related tasks.

Along the way, you'll gain hands-on experience with modern Linux terminals and shells, and learn how to manage your workloads. You'll understand how to run Linux applications by using containers, systemd, modern filesystems, and immutable distros such as Flatcar and Bottlerocket.

Use Linux as a modern work environment, rather than just from an admin perspective
Learn critical components such as the Linux kernel, terminal multiplexer, human-friendly shells, and portable shell scripting
Become familiar with access control, from file permissions to capabilities, and understand the role of filesystems as a fundamental building block
Learn about application dependency management and containers
Gain hands-on experience with the Linux networking stack and tooling, including DNS
Apply modern operating system observability to manage your workloads
Become familiar with interprocess communication, virtual machines, and selected security topics

First, you’ll learn how to install Kali on a virtual machine and get an introduction to basic Linux concepts. Next, you’ll tackle broader Linux topics like manipulating text, controlling file and directory permissions, and managing user environment variables. You’ll then focus on foundational hacking concepts like security and anonymity and learn scripting skills with bash and Python. 

Practical tutorials and exercises throughout will reinforce and test your skills as you learn how to:

Cover your tracks by changing your network information and manipulating the journalctl logging utility
Write a tool to scan for network connections, and connect and listen to wireless networks
Keep your internet activity stealthy using Tor, proxy servers, VPNs, and encrypted email
Write a bash script to find potential attack targets over a range of IP addresses
Use and abuse services like MySQL, the Apache web server, and OpenSSH
Build your own hacking tools, such as remote spy cameras and password crackers

Hacking is complex, and there is no single way in. Why not start at the beginning with Linux Basics for Hackers?

title: Understanding the Linux Kernel, 3rd Edition
description:
In order to thoroughly understand what makes Linux tick and why it works so well on a wide variety of systems, you need to delve deep into the heart of the kernel. The kernel handles all interactions between the CPU and the external world, and determines which programs will share processor time, in what order. It manages limited memory so well that hundreds of processes can share the system efficiently, and expertly organizes data transfers so that the CPU isn't kept waiting any longer than necessary for the relatively slow disks.

The third edition of Understanding the Linux Kernel takes you on a guided tour of the most significant data structures, algorithms, and programming tricks used in the kernel. Probing beyond superficial features, the authors offer valuable insights to people who want to know how things really work inside their machine. Important Intel-specific features are discussed. Relevant segments of code are dissected line by line. But the book covers more than just the functioning of the code; it explains the theoretical underpinnings of why Linux does things the way it does.

This edition of the book covers Version 2.6, which has seen significant changes to nearly every kernel subsystem, particularly in the areas of memory management and block devices. The book focuses on the following topics:

Memory management, including file buffering, process swapping, and Direct memory Access (DMA)
The Virtual Filesystem layer and the Second and Third Extended Filesystems
Process creation and scheduling
Signals, interrupts, and the essential interfaces to device drivers
Timing
Synchronization within the kernel
Interprocess Communication (IPC)
Program execution

Understanding the Linux Kernel will acquaint you with all the inner workings of Linux, but it's more than just an academic exercise. You'll learn what conditions bring out Linux's best performance, and you'll see how it meets the challenge of providing good system response during process scheduling, file access, and memory management in a wide variety of environments. This book will help you make the most of your Linux system.

Gestiona la memoria limitada tan bien que cientos de procesos pueden compartir el sistema de manera eficiente, y organiza de forma experta transferencias de datos para que la CPU no se mantenga esperando más de lo necesario para los discos relativamente lentos.

Probando más allá de las características superficiales, los autores ofrecen valiosas ideas a las personas que quieren saber cómo las cosas realmente funcionan dentro de su máquina. Gestión de memoria, incluyendo amortiguación de archivos, intercambio de procesos y acceso directo a la memoria (DMA)
La capa Virtual del sistema de archivos y los sistemas de archivos ampliados segundo y tercero
Creación de procesos y programación
Señales, interrupciones y las interfaces esenciales para los controladores de dispositivo
Horas

Interprocess Communication (IPC)
Ejecución del programa

Comprender el kernel de Linux te familiarizará con todos los trabajos internos de Linux, pero es más que un ejercicio académico. Este libro te ayudará a aprovechar al máximo tu sistema Linux.

title: Linux Application Development by Example: The Fundamental APIs, 2nd Edition
description:
Unlock the secrets of Linux system programming and take your coding skills to the next level

Do you use Linux, but not really understand it?

Have you ever wondered how ls -l knows everything it does?

Could you explain to a coworker why ls and find can be external commands but cd and umask must be built into the shell?

The answers to these questions, and more, are in Linux Application Development by Example, Second Edition! This book tells you exactly what you need to know--no more and no less--about the fundamental Linux system programming APIs.

Following the latest POSIX standard, author Arnold Robbins explains how the basic file, process, IPC and networking APIs work. When possible, he demonstrates the use of the APIs with code drawn from real programs (V7 Unix, BSD Unix, and GNU), and when that's not possible, he provides small, clearly documented and annotated, standalone example programs of his own. All code presented in the book is available for download, so you can compile, run, and modify the programs yourself.

Robbins focuses on both high-level principles and "under the hood" techniques. Along the way, he carefully addresses real-world issues like performance, portability, and robustness.

Each chapter closes with exercises, ranging from coding problems to thought experiments, to help you cement your understanding of the material covered, and all chapters have been thoroughly revised and updated for this edition, along with two chapters new in this edition.

Memory management

File I/O

File metadata

Processes, Users and groups

Sorting and searching

Argument parsing

Extended interfaces

Signals

Internationalization

Basic Networking

Debugging

And more!

Just learning to program? Switching from Windows or macOS? Already developing with Linux but interested in exploring the system call interface further? No matter which, quickly and directly, this book will help you master the fundamentals needed to build serious Linux software.

how to support computer peripherals under the Linux operating system
how to develop and write software for new hardware under Linux

title: Linux Basics for Hackers
description:
If you’re getting started along the exciting path of hacking, cybersecurity, and pentesting, Linux Basics for Hackers is an excellent first step. Using Kali Linux, an advanced penetration testing distribution of Linux, you’ll learn the basics of using the Linux operating system and acquire the tools and techniques you’ll need to take control of a Linux environment.

First, you’ll learn how to install Kali on a virtual machine and get an introduction to basic Linux concepts. Next, you’ll tackle broader Linux topics like manipulating text, controlling file and directory permissions, and managing user environment variables. You’ll then focus in on foundational hacking concepts like security and anonymity and learn scripting skills with bash and Python. Practical tutorials and exercises throughout will reinforce and test your skills as you learn how to:

•Cover your tracks by changing your network information and manipulating the rsyslog logging utility•Write a tool to scan for network connections, and connect and listen to wireless networks•Keep your internet activity stealthy using Tor, proxy servers, VPNs, and encrypted email•Write a bash script to scan open ports for potential targets•Use and abuse services like MySQL, Apache web server, and OpenSSH•Build your own hacking tools, such as a remote video spy camera and a password cracker

Hacking is complex, and there is no single way in. Why not start at the beginning with Linux Basics for Hackers?

Covers Kali Linux and Python 3

title: Malware Data Science

Domine los conceptos y el funcionamiento de la capa de bloques, incluidos los programadores I/O y Multi-Queue.
Examine la Interfaz del Sistema de Computación Pequeña (SCSI) y los diseños de almacenamiento físico en sistemas Linux.
Aprende a analizar el rendimiento de I/O en las capas de almacenamiento Linux de forma eficiente.
Obtenga información sobre la optimización y sintonización de sistemas de almacenamiento Linux para varios casos de uso.

Autor(s)

Muhammad Umer, autor de este libro perspicaz, es un experimentado profesional de Linux fascinado por el funcionamiento interno de los sistemas operativos. Su amplia experiencia con los sistemas Linux lo hace singularmente calificado para presentar complejidades técnicas de una manera accesible. La escritura de Umer abre puentes, permitiendo a los profesionales profundizar su comprensión y gestionar tecnologías avanzadas de Linux.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es perfecto para administradores de sistemas, ingenieros de almacenamiento, profesionales de Linux y entusiastas de la tecnología que buscan profundizar su comprensión de la pila de almacenamiento de Linux. Es especialmente adecuado para los lectores con conocimientos previos del sistema Linux que desean ampliar su comprensión de la arquitectura estratificada de Linux y su paisaje de almacenamiento para optimizar y solucionar problemas de manera efectiva.

title: Introduction to Abstract Algebra, 4th Edition
description:
Praise for the Third Edition

". . . an expository masterpiece of the highest didactic value that has gained additional attractivity through the various improvements . . ."—Zentralblatt MATH

The Fourth Edition of Introduction to Abstract Algebra continues to provide an accessible approach to the basic structures of abstract algebra: groups, rings, and fields. The book's unique presentation helps readers advance to abstract theory by presenting concrete examples of induction, number theory, integers modulo n, and permutations before the abstract structures are defined. Readers can immediately begin to perform computations using abstract concepts that are developed in greater detail later in the text.

The Fourth Edition features important concepts as well as specialized topics, including:

The treatment of nilpotent groups, including the Frattini and Fitting subgroups

Symmetric polynomials

The proof of the fundamental theorem of algebra using symmetric polynomials

The proof of Wedderburn's theorem on finite division rings

The proof of the Wedderburn-Artin theorem

Throughout the book, worked examples and real-world problems illustrate concepts and their applications, facilitating a complete understanding for readers regardless of their background in mathematics. A wealth of computational and theoretical exercises, ranging from basic to complex, allows readers to test their comprehension of the material. In addition, detailed historical notes and biographies of mathematicians provide context for and illuminate the discussion of key topics. A solutions manual is also available for readers who would like access to partial solutions to the book's exercises.

Introduction to Abstract Algebra, Fourth Edition is an excellent book for courses on the topic at the upper-undergraduate and beginning-graduate levels. The book also serves as a valuable reference and self-study tool for practitioners in the fields of engineering, computer science, and applied mathematics.

Alabado por la Tercera Edición

". . . una obra maestra expositivo del valor didáctico más alto que ha ganado atracción adicional a través de las diversas mejoras . ."

La presentación única del libro ayuda a los lectores a avanzar en la teoría abstracta presentando ejemplos concretos de inducción, teoría de números, modulo n enteros y permutaciones antes de definir las estructuras abstractas. Los lectores pueden comenzar inmediatamente a realizar computaciones utilizando conceptos abstractos que se desarrollan en mayor detalle más adelante en el texto.

La cuarta edición cuenta con conceptos importantes y temas especializados, incluyendo:

Tratamiento de grupos nilpotent, incluyendo los subgrupos Frattini y Fitting

Polinomios simétricos

La prueba del teorema fundamental del álgebra utilizando polinomios simétricos

La prueba del teorema de Wedderburn en anillos de división finitos

La prueba del teorema de Wedderburn-Artin

A lo largo del libro, ejemplos trabajados y problemas del mundo real ilustran conceptos y sus aplicaciones, facilitando una comprensión completa para los lectores independientemente de su fondo en matemáticas. Una riqueza de ejercicios computacionales y teóricos, que van desde lo básico hasta lo complejo, permite a los lectores probar su comprensión del material. Además, notas históricas detalladas y biografías de matemáticos proporcionan contexto e iluminan la discusión de temas clave. También está disponible un manual de soluciones para lectores que quieran acceder a soluciones parciales a los ejercicios del libro.

Introducción al álgebra abstracta, cuarta edición es un excelente libro para cursos sobre el tema en los niveles de alto grado y de primer grado. El libro también sirve como una valiosa herramienta de referencia y auto-estudio para los practicantes en los campos de ingeniería, informática, y matemáticas aplicadas.

title: SELinux System Administration, Third Edition - Third Edition
description:
SELinux System Administration, Third Edition provides a comprehensive deep dive into Security-Enhanced Linux as a mandatory access control system. By following the detailed guidance in this book, you will learn to integrate, configure, fine-tune, and create custom SELinux policies to secure Linux applications and systems effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamental concepts of SELinux and how it operates as a Linux security measure.
Learn to configure and tune SELinux policies to secure various Linux platforms and applications.
Master the use of SELinux-specific security controls, including those for containerized and virtualized environments.
Acquire skills to analyze SELinux policies and behaviors using logging and diagnostic tools.
Develop the capability to write custom SELinux policies tailored towards specific system and application needs.

Author(s)

Sven Vermeulen, the author of SELinux System Administration, is a recognized expert in Linux system security with extensive experience in managing and protecting Linux environments. His approach to writing combines technical precision with practical application, making complex topics accessible and actionable for readers.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for Linux system administrators and security professionals aiming to enhance the security of Linux systems. It is best suited for readers with a working knowledge of Linux system operations and basic security principles, who wish to gain proficiency in utilizing SELinux to achieve robust security goals. If you're looking to secure your systems using SELinux, this book is your guide.
translatedDescription:
SELinux System Administration, Third Edition ofrece una inmersión profunda integral en Linux mejorado por seguridad como un sistema de control de acceso obligatorio. Siguiendo la guía detallada de este libro, aprenderá a integrar, configurar, ajustar y crear políticas personalizadas de SELinux para asegurar aplicaciones y sistemas Linux de manera efectiva.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender los conceptos fundamentales de SELinux y cómo funciona como medida de seguridad Linux.
Aprende a configurar y sintonizar las políticas de SELinux para asegurar varias plataformas y aplicaciones de Linux.
Domine el uso de controles de seguridad específicos de SELinux, incluidos los para entornos containerizzatos y virtualizados.
Adquirir habilidades para analizar las políticas y comportamientos de SELinux utilizando herramientas de registro y diagnóstico.
Desarrollar la capacidad de escribir políticas personalizadas SELinux adaptadas a necesidades específicas de sistema y aplicaciones.

Autor(s)

Sven Vermeulen, autor de SELinux System Administration, es un reconocido experto en seguridad del sistema Linux con amplia experiencia en la gestión y protección de entornos Linux. Su enfoque de escritura combina precisión técnica con aplicación práctica, haciendo que los temas complejos sean accesibles y prácticos para los lectores.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está adaptado para los administradores del sistema Linux y los profesionales de seguridad que buscan mejorar la seguridad de los sistemas Linux. Es más adecuado para los lectores con un conocimiento de funcionamiento de las operaciones del sistema Linux y los principios básicos de seguridad, que desean obtener competencia en la utilización de SELinux para alcanzar metas de seguridad robustas. Si buscas asegurar tus sistemas usando SELinux, este libro es tu guía.

title: Professional Linux Kernel Architecture
description: Find an introduction to the architecture, concepts and algorithms of the Linux kernel in Professional Linux Kernel Architecture, a guide to the kernel sources and large number of connections among subsystems. Find an introduction to the relevant structures and functions exported by the kernel to userland, understand the theoretical and conceptual aspects of the Linux kernel and Unix derivatives, and gain a deeper understanding of the kernel. Learn how to reduce the vast amount of information contained in the kernel sources and obtain the skills necessary to understand the kernel sources.
translatedDescription: Encuentre una introducción a la arquitectura, conceptos y algoritmos del kernel de Linux en Linux Kernel Architecture Professional, una guía de las fuentes del kernel y un gran número de conexiones entre subsistemas. Encuentre una introducción a las estructuras y funciones pertinentes exportadas por el kernel a usuario, entienda los aspectos teóricos y conceptuales del kernel de Linux y los derivados de Unix, y obtenga una comprensión más profunda del núcleo. Aprende cómo reducir la gran cantidad de información contenida en las fuentes del kernel y obtener las habilidades necesarias para entender las fuentes del núcleo.

title: Linux Observability with BPF
description:
Build your expertise in the BPF virtual machine in the Linux kernel with this practical guide for systems engineers. You’ll not only dive into the BPF program lifecycle but also learn to write applications that observe and modify the kernel’s behavior; inject code to monitor, trace, and securely observe events in the kernel; and more.

Authors David Calavera and Lorenzo Fontana help you harness the power of BPF to make any computing system more observable. Familiarize yourself with the essential concepts you’ll use on a day-to-day basis and augment your knowledge about performance optimization, networking, and security. Then see how it all comes together with code examples in C, Go, and Python.

Write applications that use BPF to observe and modify the Linux kernel’s behavior on demand
Inject code to monitor, trace, and observe events in the kernel in a secure way—no need to recompile the kernel or reboot the system
Explore code examples in C, Go, and Python
Gain a more thorough understanding of the BPF program lifecycle
translatedDescription:
Construya su experiencia en la máquina virtual BPF en el kernel de Linux con esta guía práctica para ingenieros de sistemas. Usted no sólo buceará en el ciclo de vida del programa BPF sino que también aprenderá a escribir aplicaciones que observen y modifiquen el comportamiento del kernel; inyecte código para monitorear, rastrear y observar de forma segura los eventos en el núcleo; y más.

Los autores David Calavera y Lorenzo Fontana le ayudan a aprovechar el poder de BPF para que cualquier sistema informático sea más observable. Familiarícese con los conceptos esenciales que utilizará en un día a día y aumente su conocimiento sobre la optimización del rendimiento, el networking y la seguridad. A continuación, vea cómo todo se junta con ejemplos de código en C, Go, y Python.

Escribe aplicaciones que utilizan BPF para observar y modificar el comportamiento del kernel de Linux bajo demanda
Inject code to monitor, trace, and observe events in the kernel in a secure way—no need to recompile the kernel or reboot the system
Explorar ejemplos de código en C, Go y Python
Obtenga una comprensión más completa del ciclo de vida del programa BPF

title: Yocto Project Customization for Linux: The Essential Guide for Embedded Developers
description:
Embedded computers have become very complex and are now called upon to solve a range of increasingly advanced problems. This added complexity means embedded systems need even more complex operating systems in order to work as required.

The Yocto Project is now the effective standard for most embedded systems around the world due to its robustness and high configuration, availability of software packages and the ability to support several hardware platforms with common mechanisms so that developers can deploy their systems with ease regardless of the machine.

 Yocto Project Customization for Linux is not just another book talking about the Yocto Project, but shows how the Yocto Build system really works. Developers can easily and quickly move from the demo Yocto Project distributions that silicon vendors rely on for their development kits to their final product. This book is a practical guide teaching you everything you need to know about writing new recipes and customizing existing ones by explaining the Build System internals and how to manage them for your ongoing projects.

You Will Learn:

To understand Yocto Project internals and how Yocto Project tools work
How to define a new meta layer or a new machine/distro in order to generate a custom Yocto Project image for their embedded system
To generate a new Yocto Project recipe for your software, or to alter an already existing recipe in order to fit your needs
How to update one or more packages on their running Yocto Project system
How to optimize and effectively manage the Yocto Build System

Who is it for: 

This is for embedded developers as well as Linux users who want to know more how to use Yocto

Las computadoras incorporadas se han vuelto muy complejas y ahora están llamadas a resolver una serie de problemas cada vez más avanzados. Esta complejidad agregada significa que los sistemas integrados necesitan sistemas operativos aún más complejos para funcionar según sea necesario.

El Proyecto Yocto es ahora el estándar eficaz para la mayoría de los sistemas incrustados en todo el mundo debido a su robustez y alta configuración, disponibilidad de paquetes de software y la capacidad de soportar varias plataformas de hardware con mecanismos comunes para que los desarrolladores puedan desplegar sus sistemas con facilidad independientemente de la máquina.

Yocto Project Customization for Linux no es sólo otro libro que habla del Proyecto Yocto, sino que muestra cómo funciona el sistema Yocto Build. Los desarrolladores pueden moverse fácilmente y rápidamente de las distribuciones demo Yocto Project que los proveedores de silicio confían en sus kits de desarrollo a su producto final. Este libro es una guía práctica que te enseña todo lo que necesitas saber sobre escribir nuevas recetas y personalizar las existentes explicando los internos del Sistema de Construcción y cómo gestionarlas para tus proyectos en curso.

Aprenderás:

Para entender los internos del proyecto Yocto y cómo funcionan las herramientas del proyecto Yocto
Cómo definir una nueva capa meta o una nueva máquina/distro para generar una imagen personalizada del Proyecto Yocto para su sistema integrado
Para generar una nueva receta Yocto Project para su software, o para alterar una receta ya existente con el fin de satisfacer sus necesidades
Cómo actualizar uno o más paquetes en su sistema de proyectos Yocto en funcionamiento
Cómo optimizar y gestionar eficazmente el sistema Yocto Build

Para quién es:

Esto es para desarrolladores integrados, así como usuarios de Linux que quieren saber más cómo utilizar Yocto

title: Linux with Operating System Concepts, 2nd Edition
description: Linux with Operating System Concepts, 2nd Edition, merges conceptual operating system (OS) and Unix/Linux topics into one cohesive textbook for undergraduate students. The book can be used for a one- or two-semester course on Linux or Unix. It is complete with review sections, problems, definitions, and concepts.

title: Linux Bible, 10th Edition
description:
The industry favorite Linux guide

Linux Bible, 10th Edition is the ultimate hands-on Linux user guide, whether you're a true beginner or a more advanced user navigating recent changes. this updated tenth edition covers the latest versions of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 8), Fedora 30, and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. It includes information on cloud computing, with new guidance on containerization, Ansible automation, and Kubernetes and OpenShift. With a focus on RHEL 8, this new edition teaches techniques for managing storage, users, and security, while emphasizing simplified administrative techniques with Cockpit. Written by a Red Hat expert, this book provides the clear explanations and step-by-step instructions that demystify Linux and bring the new features seamlessly into your workflow.

This useful guide assumes a base of little or no Linux knowledge, and takes you step by step through what you need to know to get the job done.

Get Linux up and running quickly
Master basic operations and tackle more advanced tasks
Get up to date on the recent changes to Linux server system management
Bring Linux to the cloud using Openstack and Cloudforms
Simplified Linux administration through the Cockpit Web Interface 
Automated Linux Deployment with Ansible 
Learn to navigate Linux with Amazon (AWS), Google (GCE), and Microsofr Azure Cloud services 

Linux Bible, 10th Edition is the one resource you need, and provides the hands-on training that gets you on track in a flash.

Incluye información sobre computación en la nube, con nueva orientación sobre containerización, automatización ansible y Kubernetes y OpenShift. Sube Linux y corre rápidamente
Principales operaciones básicas y abordar tareas más avanzadas
Actualizar los recientes cambios en la gestión del sistema servidor Linux

Administración simplificada de Linux a través de la interfaz web de Cockpit

La Biblia de Linux, 10a Edición es el único recurso que necesitas, y proporciona el entrenamiento práctico que te lleva en el camino en un flash.

title: Linux Kernel Programming
description:
Delve into the world of Linux kernel programming with this hands-on guide, "Linux Kernel Programming." This book guides you through writing kernel modules, understanding critical kernel internals, and mastering key synchronization techniques. Gain practical skills and theoretical knowledge to confidently contribute to Linux kernel development.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to write modular and efficient kernel code using the LKM framework for Linux 5.x kernels.
Acquire the skills to build and configure the Linux kernel from source for customization or improvement.
Understand the underlying architecture of the Linux kernel, including memory management and CPU scheduling.
Master concurrency and synchronization mechanisms like mutexes and spinlocks to develop robust kernel modules.
Develop practical knowledge to tackle real-world Linux kernel development tasks with confidence and sophistication.

Author(s)

Kaiwan N. Billimoria is an experienced software developer with expertise in Linux and embedded systems. With a solid foundation in kernel development, he has authored technical articles and books, and led development teams through complex projects. Kaiwan shares his insights to make kernel programming accessible and approachable.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for Linux developers eager to deepen their expertise in kernel programming. Whether you're new to kernel or module development or experienced in the field but looking to enhance your skills, this guide offers tangible objectives. Prior experience with Linux systems and C programming will help you unlock the book's full potential.

Este libro le guía a través de la escritura de módulos del núcleo, la comprensión de los internos del núcleo crítico, y la masterización de técnicas de sincronización clave. Obtenga habilidades prácticas y conocimientos teóricos para contribuir con confianza al desarrollo del kernel de Linux.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Aprende a escribir código de núcleo modular y eficiente usando el marco LKM para kernels Linux 5.x.
Adquirir las habilidades para construir y configurar el kernel de Linux de origen para la personalización o mejora.
Entender la arquitectura subyacente del kernel de Linux, incluyendo gestión de memoria y programación de CPU.
Master concurrency and synchronization mechanisms like mutexes and spinlocks to develop robust kernel modules.
Desarrollar conocimientos prácticos para abordar tareas de desarrollo del kernel Linux en el mundo real con confianza y sofisticación.

Kaiwan N. Billimoria es un desarrollador de software experimentado con experiencia en Linux y sistemas integrados. Con una sólida base en el desarrollo del núcleo, ha autorizado artículos técnicos y libros, y ha dirigido equipos de desarrollo a través de proyectos complejos. Kaiwan comparte sus ideas para que la programación del núcleo sea accesible y accesible.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores de Linux deseosos de profundizar su experiencia en la programación del núcleo. Ya sea nuevo en el desarrollo del kernel o módulo o experimentado en el campo, pero buscando mejorar sus habilidades, esta guía ofrece objetivos tangibles. La experiencia previa con sistemas Linux y programación C le ayudará a desbloquear todo el potencial del libro.

title: Malware Analysis Techniques
description:
This book is your guide to the fascinating field of malware analysis. You'll start by understanding the nature of malicious software, then explore hands-on techniques for analyzing malware using both static and dynamic methods. By mastering these tools and skills, you'll be better equipped to identify, analyze, and remediate threats efficiently.

What this Book will help me do

Set up and maintain a safe environment for malware sample analysis.
Apply static and dynamic analysis techniques to identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).
Utilize reverse-engineering skills to understand the functionality of malware.
Establish a robust workflow to streamline malware analysis processes.
Leverage automation tools to further enhance your analysis capabilities.

Author(s)

Dylan Barker, an experienced malware analyst and cybersecurity expert, brings years of hands-on expertise to this book. With a robust background in incident response and threat intelligence, Dylan distills complex malware analysis concepts into accessible, practical steps. His approachable style and dedication to empowering readers make learning cybersecurity strategies both manageable and engaging.

Who is it for?

This book is a perfect fit for incident response professionals, aspiring malware analysts, and cybersecurity researchers aiming to deepen their analysis capabilities. Whether you're just starting with malware analysis or seeking advanced insights, this guide meets you at your skill level. Prior familiarity with command-line tools, scripting languages such as Python, and operating system structures will enhance your learning experience.

Este libro es su guía al fascinante campo del análisis de malware.
