Explore las herramientas administrativas disponibles para root que le permitan gestionar usuarios, sistemas de archivos, procesos y comunicaciones básicas de red
Configurar las secuencias de arranque y arranque

Quién es este libro

Cualquier persona que desee aprender Linux como un administrador avanzado de usuarios y sistemas en la línea de comandos mientras utiliza el escritorio GUI para aprovechar la productividad.

description:

title: Building Embedded Linux Systems, 2nd Edition
description:
There's a great deal of excitement surrounding the use of Linux in embedded systems -- for everything from cell phones to car ABS systems and water-filtration plants -- but not a lot of practical information. Building Embedded Linux Systems offers an in-depth, hard-core guide to putting together embedded systems based on Linux. Updated for the latest version of the Linux kernel, this new edition gives you the basics of building embedded Linux systems, along with the configuration, setup, and use of more than 40 different open source and free software packages in common use. The book also looks at the strengths and weaknesses of using Linux in an embedded system, plus a discussion of licensing issues, and an introduction to real-time, with a discussion of real-time options for Linux. This indispensable book features arcane and previously undocumented procedures for:

Building your own GNU development toolchain

Using an efficient embedded development framework

Selecting, configuring, building, and installing a target-specific kernel

Creating a complete target root filesystem

Setting up, manipulating, and using solid-state storage devices

Installing and configuring a bootloader for the target

Cross-compiling a slew of utilities and packages

Debugging your embedded system using a plethora of tools and techniques

Using the uClibc, BusyBox, U-Boot, OpenSSH, thttpd, tftp, strace, and gdb packages

By presenting how to build the operating system components from pristine sources and how to find more documentation or help, Building Embedded Linux Systems greatly simplifies the task of keeping complete control over your embedded operating system.
translatedDescription:
Hay una gran cantidad de emoción en torno al uso de Linux en sistemas integrados -- para todo desde teléfonos celulares a sistemas de autos ABS y plantas de llenado de agua -- pero no mucha información práctica. Building Embedded Linux Systems ofrece una guía en profundidad y de núcleo duro para reunir sistemas integrados basados en Linux. Actualizado para la última versión del kernel de Linux, esta nueva edición le da los fundamentos de la construcción de sistemas Linux integrados, junto con la configuración, configuración y uso de más de 40 paquetes de código abierto y software libre diferentes en uso común. El libro también analiza las fortalezas y debilidades del uso de Linux en un sistema integrado, además de una discusión sobre temas de licencia, y una introducción a tiempo real, con una discusión de opciones en tiempo real para Linux. Este libro indispensable cuenta con procedimientos arcanos y previamente indocumentados para:

Construyendo su propia cadena de herramientas de desarrollo GNU

Utilizando un marco de desarrollo integrado eficiente

Selección, configuración, construcción e instalación de un núcleo específico

Creación de un sistema de archivos raíz de destino completo

Configuración, manipulación y uso de dispositivos de almacenamiento de estado sólido

Instalación y configuración de un cargador de arranque para el objetivo

Cruzando un montón de utilidades y paquetes

Depurar su sistema incrustado usando una plétora de herramientas y técnicas

Utilizando los paquetes uClibc, BusyBox, U-Boot, OpenSSH, thttpd, tftp, strace y gdb

Al presentar cómo construir los componentes del sistema operativo de fuentes prístinas y cómo encontrar más documentación o ayuda, Building Embedded Linux Systems simplifica enormemente la tarea de mantener el control completo sobre su sistema operativo integrado.

title: Linux Sound Programming
description:
Program audio and sound for Linux using this practical, how-to guide. You will learn how to use DSPs, sampled audio, MIDI, karaoke, streaming audio, and more. Linux Sound Programming takes you through the layers of complexity involved in programming the Linux sound system. You'll see the large variety of tools and approaches that apply to almost every aspect of sound. This ranges from audio codecs, to audio players, to audio support both within and outside of the Linux kernel.

What You'll Learn

Work with sampled audio

Handle Digital Signal Processing (DSP)

Gain knowledge of MIDI

Build a Karaoke-like application

Handle streaming audio

Who This Book Is For

Experienced Linux users and programmers interested in doing multimedia with Linux.

Verás la gran variedad de herramientas y enfoques que se aplican a casi todos los aspectos del sonido. Esto va desde codecs de audio, hasta reproductores de audio, hasta soporte de audio tanto dentro como fuera del kernel de Linux.

Lo que aprenderás

Trabajar con audio muestrado

Procesamiento de señalización digital (DSP)

Conocimiento de MIDI

Construir una aplicación tipo Karaoke

title: Resolving Conflicts at Work: Ten Strategies for Everyone on the Job, Third Edition
description:
The classic text on resolving workplace conflicts, fully revised and updated

Resolving Conflicts at Work is a guide for preventing and resolving conflicts, miscommunications, and misunderstandings at work, including dozens of techniques for revealing how the inevitable disputes and divisions in the workplace are actually opportunities for greater creativity, productivity, enhanced morale, and personal growth. In the third edition of this text, all chapters are completely infused with additional content, updated examples, and new case studies. Like its predecessors, it identifies core strategies for preventing and resolving both intermittent and chronic conflicts in the workplace. In addition, the book

Includes a new foreword by Warren Bennis, which represents his most recent thinking about judgment calls and candid communications in the workplace

Presents new chapters on leadership and transformational conflict coaching, and organizational systems design

Features downloadable teaching materials available for faculty using the book

This definitive and comprehensive work provides a handy guide for managers, employees, union representatives, human resource experts, and consultants seeking to maintain stable and productive workplaces.

Resolver conflictos en el trabajo es una guía para prevenir y resolver conflictos, malcomunicaciones y malentendidos en el trabajo, incluyendo decenas de técnicas para revelar cómo las inevitables disputas y divisiones en el lugar de trabajo son en realidad oportunidades para una mayor creatividad, productividad, mayor moral y crecimiento personal. En la tercera edición de este texto, todos los capítulos están completamente infundidos con contenido adicional, ejemplos actualizados y nuevos estudios de casos. Al igual que sus predecesores, identifica estrategias básicas para prevenir y resolver conflictos intermitentes y crónicos en el lugar de trabajo. Además, el libro

Incluye un nuevo prólogo de Warren Bennis, que representa su pensamiento más reciente sobre las llamadas de juicio y las comunicaciones en el lugar de trabajo

Presenta nuevos capítulos sobre liderazgo y formación de conflictos transformadores, y diseño de sistemas organizativos

Características materiales de enseñanza descargables disponibles para profesores usando el libro

Este trabajo definitivo e integral proporciona una guía práctica para directivos, empleados, representantes sindicales, expertos en recursos humanos y consultores que buscan mantener un lugar de trabajo estable y productivo.

title: Linear Programming and Resource Allocation Modeling
description:
Guides in the application of linear programming to firm decision making, with the goal of giving decision-makers a better understanding of methods at their disposal

Useful as a main resource or as a supplement in an economics or management science course, this comprehensive book addresses the deficiencies of other texts when it comes to covering linear programming theory—especially where data envelopment analysis (DEA) is concerned—and provides the foundation for the development of DEA.

Linear Programming and Resource Allocation Modeling begins by introducing primal and dual problems via an optimum product mix problem, and reviews the rudiments of vector and matrix operations. It then goes on to cover: the canonical and standard forms of a linear programming problem; the computational aspects of linear programming; variations of the standard simplex theme; duality theory; single- and multiple- process production functions; sensitivity analysis of the optimal solution; structural changes; and parametric programming. The primal and dual problems are then reformulated and re-examined in the context of Lagrangian saddle points, and a host of duality and complementary slackness theorems are offered. The book also covers primal and dual quadratic programs, the complementary pivot method, primal and dual linear fractional functional programs, and (matrix) game theory solutions via linear programming, and data envelopment analysis (DEA). This book:

Appeals to those wishing to solve linear optimization problems in areas such as economics, business administration and management, agriculture and energy, strategic planning, public decision making, and health care
Fills the need for a linear programming applications component in a management science or economics course
Provides a complete treatment of linear programming as applied to activity selection and usage
Contains many detailed example problems as well as textual and graphical explanations

Linear Programming and Resource Allocation Modeling is an excellent resource for professionals looking to solve linear optimization problems, and advanced undergraduate to beginning graduate level management science or economics students.
translatedDescription:
Guías para la aplicación de la programación lineal a la adopción de decisiones firmes, con el objetivo de dar a los encargados de adoptar decisiones una mejor comprensión de los métodos a su disposición

Útil como recurso principal o como suplemento en un curso de economía o ciencia de gestión, este libro integral aborda las deficiencias de otros textos cuando se trata de cubrir la teoría de programación lineal, especialmente en lo que respecta al análisis de la envelopmentación de datos (DEA) y proporciona la base para el desarrollo de DEA.

Programación lineal y asignación de recursos La modelación comienza introduciendo problemas primarios y duales a través de un problema óptimo de mezcla de productos, y revisa los rudimentos de las operaciones vectoriales y matriz. Luego continúa para cubrir: las formas canónicas y estándar de un problema de programación lineal; los aspectos computacionales de la programación lineal; variaciones del tema simple estándar; teoría de la dualidad; funciones de producción de procesos individuales y múltiples; análisis de sensibilidad de la solución óptima; cambios estructurales; y programación paramétrica. Los problemas primarios y duales se reformulan y reexaminan en el contexto de los puntos de silla Lagrangia, y se ofrece una gran cantidad de teoremas de dualidad y de eslabriedad complementaria. El libro también cubre programas cuadráticos primarios y duales, el método de pivote complementario, los programas funcionales fraccionales primaria y dual lineal, y (matrix) soluciones de teoría del juego mediante programación lineal, y análisis de envelopment de datos (DEA). Este libro:

Hace un llamamiento a quienes deseen resolver problemas de optimización lineal en esferas como la economía, la administración y la gestión de empresas, la agricultura y la energía, la planificación estratégica, la toma de decisiones públicas y la atención de la salud
Rellena la necesidad de un componente de aplicaciones de programación lineal en un curso de ciencia de gestión o economía
Proporciona un tratamiento completo de la programación lineal aplicado a la selección y uso de la actividad
Contiene muchos problemas de ejemplo detallados, así como explicaciones textuales y gráficas

Linear Programming and Resource Allocation Modeling es un excelente recurso para los profesionales que buscan resolver problemas de optimización lineal, y avanzado grado para comenzar la gestión de nivel de posgrado o estudiantes de economía.

title: Learning Linux Binary Analysis
description:
Learning Linux Binary Analysis delves into the intricacies of the ELF binary format and techniques utilized in reverse engineering and binary forensics. Through this book, you'll uncover the essentials of analyzing Linux binaries, detecting and managing security threats, and building your expertise in hacking and forensic analysis.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the ELF binary format and its role in Linux systems.
Learn to reverse engineer binaries effectively and perform forensic analysis.
Master the techniques to detect and manage Linux binary infections and rootkits.
Develop tools and methods for binary hardening and code patching.
Gain insight into advanced malware analysis and debugging methodologies.

Author(s)

None "elfmaster" O'Neill is a seasoned expert in Linux binary analysis with extensive experience in reverse engineering and security research. With a commitment to sharing knowledge, the author has crafted this book to provide deep insights into the world of Linux binary forensics. Their approach emphasizes practical techniques complemented by real-world examples.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for software engineers and security professionals who wish to enhance their skills in Linux binary analysis. If you have a basic understanding of the C programming language and Linux environments, this book can guide you through advanced concepts and techniques. Security enthusiasts and system-level programmers looking to strengthen their forensic and analytical capabilities will find it invaluable.

A través de este libro, descubrirás los elementos esenciales de analizar binarios Linux, detectar y gestionar amenazas de seguridad y crear tu experiencia en piratería y análisis forense.

Entender el formato binario ELF y su papel en los sistemas Linux.
Aprende a revertir los binarios de ingeniería de manera efectiva y realizar análisis forenses.

title: Security Strategies in Linux Platforms and Applications, 3rd Edition
description: The third edition of Security Strategies in Linux Platforms and Applications covers every major aspect of security on a Linux system. Using real-world examples and exercises, this useful resource incorporates hands-on activities to walk readers through the fundamentals of security strategies related to the Linux system. Written by an industry expert, this book is divided into three natural parts to illustrate key concepts in the field. It opens with a discussion of the risks, threats, and vulnerabilities associated with Linux as an operating system using current examples and cases. Part 2 discusses how to take advantage of the layers of security available to Linux--user and group options, filesystems, and security options for important services. The book closes with a look at the use of both open source and proprietary tools when building a layered security strategy for Linux operating system environments.

Utilizando ejemplos y ejercicios del mundo real, este recurso útil incorpora actividades prácticas para guiar a los lectores a través de los fundamentos de las estrategias de seguridad relacionadas con el sistema Linux. Escrito por un experto en la industria, este libro se divide en tres partes naturales para ilustrar conceptos clave en el campo. Se abre con una discusión de los riesgos, amenazas y vulnerabilidades asociados con Linux como un sistema operativo utilizando ejemplos y casos actuales. La parte 2 discute cómo aprovechar las capas de seguridad disponibles para Linux: opciones de usuario y grupo, sistemas de archivos y opciones de seguridad para servicios importantes. El libro cierra con un vistazo al uso de herramientas de código abierto y patentadas al construir una estrategia de seguridad con capas para entornos del sistema operativo Linux.

title: Using and Administering Linux: Volume 2: Zero to SysAdmin: Advanced Topics
description:
Learn to be a Linux sysadmin and an expert user of the Linux operating system, even with no previous Linux experience. This second edition of the popular and highly rated Linux self-study training course has been fully updated to Fedora Linux 37 with expanded and revised content and figures as well new chapters on the BTRFS file system, using Zram for swap, NetworkManager, automation with Ansible, and systemd.

Like the previous version, this edition has been reviewed for technical accuracy by a highly respected Linux expert and will prepare you to manage complex systems with ease and equip you for a new career. It has also been reviewed by a student who took this course to ensure its readability and flow for those with little or no previous experience with Linux. This second volume builds upon what you learned in the first and depends upon the virtual network and virtual machine created there.

You’ll see how to manage and monitor running processes, discover the power ofthe special filesystems, monitor and tune the kernel while it is running – without a reboot. You’ll then turn to regular expressions and the power that using them for pattern matching can bring to the command line, and learn to manage printers and printing from the command line and unlock the secrets of the hardware on which your Linux operating system is running.

Experiment with command line programming and how to automate various administrative tasks, networking, and the many services that are required in a Linux system. Use the logs and journals to look for clues to problems and confirmation that things are working correctly, and learn to enhance the security of your Linux systems and how to perform easy local and remote backups. 

What You Will Learn

Understand Logical Volume Management, using file managers, and special filesystems
Exploit everything is a file
Perform command line programming and basic automation
Configure printers and manage other hardware
Manage system services with systemd, user management, security, and local and remote backups using simple and freely available tools

Who This Book Is For

Anyone who wants to continue to learn Linux in depth as an advanced user and system administrator at the command line while using the GUI desktop to leverage productivity.

Al igual que la versión anterior, esta edición ha sido revisada para la precisión técnica por un experto Linux muy respetado y le preparará para gestionar sistemas complejos con facilidad y equiparle para una nueva carrera. También ha sido revisado por un estudiante que tomó este curso para garantizar su legibilidad y flujo para aquellos con poca o ninguna experiencia previa con Linux. Este segundo volumen se basa en lo que aprendió en el primero y depende de la red virtual y la máquina virtual creada allí.

Verás cómo gestionar y supervisar los procesos de ejecución, descubrirás el poder de los sistemas de archivos especiales, monitorearás y sintonizarás el núcleo mientras se ejecuta – sin reiniciar. A continuación, girará a las expresiones regulares y la potencia que utilizarlas para emparejar patrones puede llevar a la línea de comandos, y aprenderá a gestionar impresoras e imprimir desde la línea de comandos y desbloquear los secretos del hardware en el que se ejecuta su sistema operativo Linux.

Experimente con la programación de líneas de comandos y cómo automatizar diversas tareas administrativas, redes y los muchos servicios que se requieren en un sistema Linux. Utilice los registros y las revistas para buscar pistas sobre problemas y confirmar que las cosas funcionan correctamente, y aprender a mejorar la seguridad de sus sistemas Linux y cómo realizar copias de seguridad locales y remotas fáciles.

Comprender la gestión del volumen lógico, utilizando gestores de archivos y sistemas de archivos especiales

Cualquier persona que quiera seguir aprendiendo Linux en profundidad como un usuario avanzado y administrador del sistema en la línea de comandos mientras utiliza el escritorio de GUI para aprovechar la productividad.

title: Linear Algebra with Applications, 10th Edition
description:
A thorough and accessible introduction to linear algebra, delivered digitally.

The new 10th Edition of Linear Algebra with Applications continues to encourage a challenging and broad understanding of the subject.

For this edition, Steve Leon – one of the leading figures in the use of technology for linear algebra – is joined by new co-author Lisette de Pillis of Harvey Mudd College, who brings her passion for teaching and solving real-world problems to this revision.

Key to the 10th Edition was transforming from a primarily print-based resource to a digital learning tool. The eText is packed with content and tools, such as interactive figures, that help bring course content to life for students and augment instruction. This change in format supports the authors’ hallmark – using modern practical application to make key concepts tangible and demonstrating how mathematics is used in the real world.

Each chapter contains integrated worked examples, practical applications, computer exercises, and chapter tests. The important roles played by geometry and visualization in understanding linear algebra are emphasized.

For sophomore-level or junior/senior-level first courses in linear algebra; assumes calculus as a prerequisite.

Pearson eText allows educators to easily share their own notes with students so they see the connection between their reading and what they learn in class – motivating them to keep reading, and keep learning. Portable access lets students study on the go, even offline. And, student usage analytics offer insight into how students use the eText, helping educators tailor their instruction.

title: Linear Algebra and Matrix Analysis for Statistics
description: Assuming no prior knowledge of linear algebra, this self-contained text offers a gradual exposition to linear algebra without sacrificing the rigor of the subject. It presents both the vector space approach and the canonical forms in matrix theory.

title: Interprocess Communications in Linux®: The Nooks & Crannies
description:
The definitive guide to Linux processes and IPC for programmers and system administrators

Pipes, message queues, semaphores, shared memory, RPC, sockets, the /proc filesystem, and much more

In-depth coverage of multithreading with POSIX compliant LinuxThreads

Contains dozens of detailedprogram examples (GNU C/C++ 2.96/Red Hat Linux 7.3 & 8.0)

Raves for Gray's companion UNIX® volume!

"Concepts I only vaguely understood now make complete sense to me! The sample code and exercises are so good,they seem to clamp down on the concepts like a vise grip..."—S. Lee Henry, Johns HopkinsUniversity

The expert, example-rich guide to Linuxprocesses and IPC

Serious Linux software developers need a sophisticated understanding of processes, system level programming andinterprocess communication techniques. Now, John Shapley Gray, author of the widely praised Interprocess Communicationin UNIX, Second Edition, zeroes in on the core techniques Linux uses to manage processes and IPC. With exceptionalprecision and great clarity, Gray explains what processes are, how they're generated, how they access their environments,how they communicate—and how to use them to build robust, high-performance systems.

Includes extensive coverage of named/unnamed pipes, message queues, semaphores, and shared memory.

Provides C++ classes for System V IPC facilities.

Offers an in-depth introduction to socket-basedcommunication.

Demystifies Linux's /proc file system.

Illuminates the LinuxThreads POSIX threadimplementation and its use in multithreaded applications.

Provides valuable tips and warnings, plus insight intokey differences amongst Linux and Unix implementations.

Includes problem sets and illustrations designed toreinforce key concepts.

Gray presents dozens of standalone program examples; all compiled with the GNU C/C++ compiler 2.96 & 3.2, and fullytested on PC platforms running Red Hat Linux 7.3 & 8.0.

http://authors.phptr.com/gray/

Cobertura en profundidad de multithreading con LinuxThreads compatibles con POSIX

Los desarrolladores de software Linux serios necesitan una comprensión sofisticada de los procesos, la programación del nivel del sistema y las técnicas de comunicación de interproceso. Ahora, John Shapley Gray, autor del ampliamente elogiado Interprocess Communicationin UNIX, Second Edition, ceros en las técnicas básicas que Linux utiliza para gestionar procesos e IPC. Ilumina los hilos de LinuxThreads POSIX y su uso en aplicaciones multiteleadas.

Proporciona consejos y advertencias valiosos, además de información sobre las diferencias clave entre las implementaciones Linux y Unix.

Incluye conjuntos de problemas e ilustraciones diseñadas para reforzar conceptos clave.

Gray presenta docenas de ejemplos de programas independientes; todos compilados con el compilador GNU C/C+++ 2.96 & 3.2, y completamente probados en plataformas de PC ejecutando Red Hat Linux 7.3 > 8.0.

title: Linux Kernel in a Nutshell
description:
Written by a leading developer and maintainer of the Linux kernel, Linux Kernel in a Nutshell is a comprehensive overview of kernel configuration and building, a critical task for Linux users and administrators.

No distribution can provide a Linux kernel that meets all users' needs. Computers big and small have special requirements that require reconfiguring and rebuilding the kernel. Whether you are trying to get sound, wireless support, and power management working on a laptop or incorporating enterprise features such as logical volume management on a large server, you can benefit from the insights in this book.

Linux Kernel in a Nutshell covers the entire range of kernel tasks, starting with downloading the source and making sure that the kernel is in sync with the versions of the tools you need. In addition to configuration and installation steps, the book offers reference material and discussions of related topics such as control of kernel options at runtime.

A key benefit of the book is a chapter on determining exactly what drivers are needed for your hardware. Also included are recipes that list what you need to do to accomplish a wide range of popular tasks.
translatedDescription:
Escrito por un desarrollador y encargado líder del kernel de Linux, Linux Kernel en Nutshell es una visión general de la configuración y construcción del núcleo, una tarea crítica para los usuarios y administradores de Linux.

Ninguna distribución puede proporcionar un kernel de Linux que satisfaga todas las necesidades de los usuarios. Las computadoras grandes y pequeñas tienen requisitos especiales que requieren reconfiguración y reconstrucción del núcleo. Ya sea que usted está tratando de obtener sonido, soporte inalámbrico y gestión de energía trabajando en un portátil o incorporando características empresariales como la gestión lógica del volumen en un servidor grande, usted puede beneficiarse de las ideas en este libro.

Linux Kernel en Nutshell cubre toda la gama de tareas del kernel, empezando por descargar la fuente y cerciorándose de que el núcleo está sincronizado con las versiones de las herramientas que necesita. Además de los pasos de configuración e instalación, el libro ofrece material de referencia y debates sobre temas relacionados como el control de las opciones del núcleo en tiempo de ejecución.

Un beneficio clave del libro es un capítulo para determinar exactamente qué controladores son necesarios para su hardware. También se incluyen recetas que enumeran lo que necesita hacer para realizar una amplia gama de tareas populares.

title: Mastering Ubuntu Server - Third Edition
description:
Mastering Ubuntu Server is a hands-on guide that covers all aspects of deploying, configuring, managing, and troubleshooting Ubuntu Server. Starting from the basics, this book will gradually build your skills toward mastering server administration using Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

What this Book will help me do

Effectively manage users, groups, and permissions, enabling better security and user management.
Automate server configurations with Ansible and streamline deployment workflows.
Securely configure remote access using Secure Shell (SSH) and learn encryption techniques with LUKS.
Leverage advanced virtualization and containerization techniques to maximize resource usage.
Deploy cloud infrastructure with Terraform and orchestrate containers with Kubernetes.

Author(s)

Jay LaCroix is an experienced system administrator and Linux educator, with over a decade of expertise in managing Linux-based servers. He has a deep passion for open-source technologies and enjoys teaching others to master them. Drawing from his practical industry experience, Jay delivers content that is approachable, thorough, and highly actionable.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for system administrators and DevOps professionals who are looking to expand their knowledge of Linux-based systems with a focus on Ubuntu Server. It assumes basic familiarity with Linux and the command line, making it accessible to those with entry-level experience. This guide is perfect for individuals aiming to master server management and integration for professional settings. If you're looking to improve your ability to deploy and maintain enterprise systems, this book will help you achieve that.
translatedDescription:
Mastering Ubuntu Server es una guía práctica que cubre todos los aspectos de implementar, configurar, gestionar y solucionar problemas Ubuntu Server. Partiendo de lo básico, este libro gradualmente desarrollará sus habilidades para dominar la administración del servidor usando Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Gestión eficaz de usuarios, grupos y permisos, lo que permite una mejor seguridad y gestión de usuarios.
Automatizar las configuraciones del servidor con los flujos de trabajo Ansible y simplificado.
Configure el acceso remoto de forma segura usando Secure Shell (SSH) y aprenda técnicas de encriptación con LUKS.
Aproveche técnicas avanzadas de virtualización y containerización para maximizar el uso de recursos.
Implementar infraestructura en la nube con contenedores Terraform y orquestados con Kubernetes.

Autor(s)

Jay LaCroix es un administrador experimentado del sistema y educador de Linux, con más de una década de experiencia en la gestión de servidores basados en Linux. Tiene una profunda pasión por las tecnologías de código abierto y disfruta enseñando a otros a dominarlas. Basándose en su experiencia práctica en la industria, Jay ofrece contenido que es accesible, minucioso y altamente factible.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para administradores de sistemas y profesionales de DevOps que buscan ampliar su conocimiento de sistemas basados en Linux con un enfoque en Ubuntu Server. Asume la familiaridad básica con Linux y la línea de comandos, haciendo que sea accesible a aquellos con experiencia de entrada. Esta guía es perfecta para personas que buscan dominar la gestión del servidor e integración para configuraciones profesionales. Si buscas mejorar tu capacidad de implementar y mantener sistemas empresariales, este libro te ayudará a lograrlo.

title: Rootkits and Bootkits
description:
Rootkits and Bootkits will teach you how to understand and counter sophisticated, advanced threats buried deep in a machine’s boot process or UEFI firmware.

With the aid of numerous case studies and professional research from three of the world’s leading security experts, you’ll trace malware development over time from rootkits like TDL3 to present-day UEFI implants and examine how they infect a system, persist through reboot, and evade security software. As you inspect and dissect real malware, you’ll learn:

•How Windows boots—including 32-bit, 64-bit, and UEFI mode—and where to find vulnerabilities•The details of boot process security mechanisms like Secure Boot, including an overview of Virtual Secure Mode (VSM) and Device Guard•Reverse engineering and forensic techniques for analyzing real malware, including bootkits like Rovnix/Carberp, Gapz, TDL4, and the infamous rootkits TDL3 and Festi•How to perform static and dynamic analysis using emulation and tools like Bochs and IDA Pro•How to better understand the delivery stage of threats against BIOS and UEFI firmware in order to create detection capabilities•How to use virtualization tools like VMware Workstation to reverse engineer bootkits and the Intel Chipsec tool to dig into forensic analysis

Cybercrime syndicates and malicious actors will continue to write ever more persistent and covert attacks, but the game is not lost. Explore the cutting edge of malware analysis with Rootkits and Bootkits.

Covers boot processes for Windows 32-bit and 64-bit operating systems.
translatedDescription:
Rootkits y Bootkits le enseñarán cómo entender y contrarrestar las amenazas avanzadas y sofisticadas sepultadas profundamente en el proceso de arranque de una máquina o firmware de la UEFI.

Con la ayuda de numerosos estudios de casos e investigación profesional de tres de los principales expertos en seguridad del mundo, rastreará el desarrollo de malware con el tiempo de rootkits como TDL3 a implantes actuales de la UEFI y examinará cómo infectan un sistema, persisten a través del reinicio y evaden el software de seguridad. Al inspeccionar y diseccionar malware real, usted aprenderá:

•Cómo arranca Windows, incluyendo 32 bits, 64 bits y modo UEFI, y dónde encontrar vulnerabilidades• Los detalles de los mecanismos de seguridad del proceso de arranque como Secure Boot, incluyendo una visión general de Virtual Secure Mode (VSM) y Device Guard• Técnicas inversas de ingeniería y forense para analizar malware real, incluyendo botines como Rovnix/Carberp, Gapz, TDL4, y los rootkits infamosos TDL3 y Festi•Cómo realizar análisis estáticos y dinámicos utilizando emulación y herramientas como Bochs e IDA Pro•Cómo entender mejor la etapa de entrega de amenazas contra BIOS y firmware UEFI para crear capacidades de detección• Cómo utilizar herramientas de virtualización como VMware Workstation para revertir los bootkits de ingeniería y la herramienta Intel Chipsec para profundizar en el análisis forense

Los sindicatos de cibercrimen y los actores maliciosos seguirán escribiendo ataques cada vez más persistentes y encubiertos, pero el juego no se pierde. Explore el borde de corte del análisis de malware con Rootkits y Bootkits.

Cubre los procesos de arranque para sistemas operativos de 32 bits y 64 bits.

title: Fighting Phishing
description:
Keep valuable data safe from even the most sophisticated social engineering and phishing attacks

Fighting Phishing: Everything You Can Do To Fight Social Engineering and Phishing serves as the ideal defense against phishing for any reader, from large organizations to individuals. Unlike most anti-phishing books, which focus only on one or two strategies, this book discusses all the policies, education, and technical strategies that are essential to a complete phishing defense. This book gives clear instructions for deploying a great defense-in-depth strategy to defeat hackers and malware. Written by the lead data-driven defense evangelist at the world's number one anti-phishing company, KnowBe4, Inc., this guide shows you how to create an enduring, integrated cybersecurity culture.

Learn what social engineering and phishing are, why they are so dangerous to your cybersecurity, and how to defend against them
Educate yourself and other users on how to identify and avoid phishing scams, to stop attacks before they begin
Discover the latest tools and strategies for locking down data when phishing has taken place, and stop breaches from spreading
Develop technology and security policies that protect your organization against the most common types of social engineering and phishing

Anyone looking to defend themselves or their organization from phishing will appreciate the uncommonly comprehensive approach in Fighting Phishing.
translatedDescription:
Mantener datos valiosos a salvo de los ataques más sofisticados de ingeniería social y phishing

Fighting Phishing: Todo lo que puedes hacer para luchar contra la ingeniería social y el Phishing sirve como la defensa ideal contra el phishing para cualquier lector, de grandes organizaciones a individuos. A diferencia de la mayoría de los libros anti-phishing, que se centran sólo en una o dos estrategias, este libro discute todas las políticas, la educación y las estrategias técnicas que son esenciales para una defensa total de phishing. Este libro da instrucciones claras para desplegar una gran estrategia de defensa en profundidad para derrotar hackers y malware. Escrito por el evangelista de defensa dirigido por datos en la compañía anti-phishing número uno del mundo, KnowBe4, Inc., esta guía le muestra cómo crear una cultura de ciberseguridad duradera e integrada.

Aprenda lo que son la ingeniería social y el phishing, por qué son tan peligrosos para su ciberseguridad, y cómo defenderse contra ellos
Educate a ti mismo y a otros usuarios sobre cómo identificar y evitar estafas de phishing, para detener los ataques antes de empezar
Descubra las últimas herramientas y estrategias para bloquear los datos cuando se ha producido el phishing, y deje de propagar las brechas
Desarrollar políticas tecnológicas y de seguridad que protejan a su organización contra los tipos más comunes de ingeniería social y phishing

Cualquier persona que busque defenderse o su organización de phishing apreciará el enfoque incomunalmente completo en la lucha contra el Phishing.

title: Land of Lisp
description: Lisp is a uniquely powerful programming language that, despite its academic reputation, is actually very practical. Land of Lisp brings the language into the real world, teaching readers Lisp by showing them how to write several complete Lisp-based games, including a text adventure, an evolution simulation, and a robot battle. While building these games, readers learn the core concepts of Lisp programming, such as recursion, input/output, object-oriented programming, and macros. And thanks to Lisp's powerful syntax, the example code is short and easy to understand. The book is filled with the author's brilliant Lisp cartoons, which are sure to appeal to many Lisp fans and, in the tradition of all No Starch Press titles, make learning more fun.
translatedDescription: Lisp es un lenguaje de programación excepcionalmente poderoso que, a pesar de su reputación académica, es en realidad muy práctico. Land of Lisp trae el lenguaje al mundo real, enseñando lectores Lisp mostrándoles cómo escribir varios juegos completos basados en Lisp, incluyendo una aventura de texto, una simulación de evolución y una batalla robot. Al construir estos juegos, los lectores aprenden los conceptos básicos de la programación de Lisp, como la recursión, entrada/salida, programación orientada al objeto y macros. Y gracias a la poderosa sintaxis de Lisp, el código de ejemplo es corto y fácil de entender. El libro está lleno de los brillantes dibujos animados Lisp del autor, que están seguros de atraer a muchos fans de Lisp y, en la tradición de todos los títulos de No Starch Press, hacer el aprendizaje más divertido.

title: The Art of Mac Malware, Volume 2
description:
As renowned Mac security expert Patrick Wardle notes in The Art of Mac Malware, Volume 2, the substantial and growing number of Mac users, both personal and enterprise, has created a compelling incentive for malware authors to ever more frequently target macOS systems. The only effective way to counter these constantly evolving and increasingly sophisticated threats is through learning and applying robust heuristic-based detection techniques.

To that end, Wardle draws upon decades of experience to guide you through the programmatic implementation of such detection techniques. By exploring how to leverage macOS’s security-centric frameworks (both public and private), diving into key elements of behavioral-based detection, and highlighting relevant examples of real-life malware, Wardle teaches and underscores the efficacy of these powerful approaches.

Across 14 in-depth chapters, you’ll learn how to:

Capture critical snapshots of system state to reveal the subtle signs of infection
Enumerate and analyze running processes to uncover evidence of malware
Parse the macOS’s distribution and binary file formats to detect malicious anomalies
Utilize code signing as an effective tool to identify malware and reduce false positives
Write efficient code that harnesses the full potential of Apple’s public and private APIs
Leverage Apple’s Endpoint Security and Network Extension frameworks to build real-time monitoring tools

This comprehensive guide provides you with the knowledge to develop tools and techniques, and to neutralize threats before it’s too late.
translatedDescription:
Como renombrada experta en seguridad de Mac Patrick Wardle anota en The Art of Mac Malware, Volumen 2, el número sustancial y creciente de usuarios de Mac, tanto personales como empresariales, ha creado un incentivo convincente para que los autores de malware se dirijan con más frecuencia a sistemas macOS. La única manera eficaz de contrarrestar estas amenazas constantemente cambiantes y cada vez más sofisticadas es aprender y aplicar técnicas de detección sólidas basadas en la heurística.

Para ello, Wardle aprovecha décadas de experiencia para guiarle a través de la implementación programática de tales técnicas de detección. Al explorar cómo aprovechar los marcos centrados en la seguridad de macOS (tanto públicos como privados), sumergirse en elementos clave de la detección basada en el comportamiento, y resaltar ejemplos relevantes de malware real-life, Wardle enseña y subraya la eficacia de estos enfoques poderosos.

A través de 14 capítulos en profundidad, usted aprenderá a:

Capturar instantáneas críticas del estado del sistema para revelar los signos sutiles de infección
Enumerar y analizar procesos de ejecución para descubrir evidencia de malware
Parse la distribución de macOS y formatos de archivo binarios para detectar anomalías maliciosas
Utilizar la firma de códigos como una herramienta eficaz para identificar malware y reducir falsos positivos
Escriba código eficiente que aproveche todo el potencial de las API públicas y privadas de Apple
Aproveche los marcos Endpoint Security y Network Extension de Apple para crear herramientas de monitoreo en tiempo real

Esta guía integral le proporciona el conocimiento para desarrollar herramientas y técnicas, y para neutralizar las amenazas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

title: Linux on Azure
description:
With multiple distributions, evolving cloud services, and complex deployment considerations, navigating Linux in Azure can be overwhelming. Linux on Azure: A Practical Guide equips IT professionals, cloud architects, and DevOps engineers with the knowledge and strategies they need to deploy, manage, and optimize Linux-based workloads with confidence.

This guide explores key Azure services and how they integrate with Linux to provide enhanced performance, security, and scalability. Covering Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu, SUSE, and Azure Linux, it provides a clear road map for running everything from cloud native and AI-driven applications to mission-critical enterprise workloads. Whether you're migrating existing systems or building new solutions, this book delivers the practical insights and hands-on strategies needed to streamline operations, reduce costs, and unlock the full power of Linux on Azure.

Understand IaaS, PaaS, and cloud native deployment options
Deploy Linux workloads efficiently using Azure tools
Optimize security, performance, and cost-efficiency
Automate infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines and Azure Compute Gallery
translatedDescription:
Con múltiples distribuciones, servicios en evolución de la nube y consideraciones complejas de implementación, navegar Linux en Azure puede ser abrumador. Linux on Azure: Una Guía práctica equipa a profesionales de TI, arquitectos de nubes y ingenieros DevOps con los conocimientos y estrategias que necesitan para desplegar, gestionar y optimizar cargas de trabajo basadas en Linux con confianza.

Esta guía explora los servicios clave Azure y cómo se integran con Linux para proporcionar un rendimiento mejorado, seguridad y escalabilidad. Cubrir Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu, SUSE y Azure Linux, proporciona una hoja de ruta clara para ejecutar todo desde aplicaciones nativas de la nube y basadas en IA a cargas de trabajo de empresa crítica misión. Si estás migrando sistemas existentes o construyendo nuevas soluciones, este libro ofrece las ideas prácticas y estrategias prácticas necesarias para simplificar las operaciones, reducir costos y desbloquear todo el poder de Linux en Azure.

Comprender las opciones de implementación nativa de IaaS, PaaS y cloud
Implementar cargas de trabajo de Linux de manera eficiente utilizando herramientas Azure
Optimize security, performance, and cost-eficiency
Automatizar la infraestructura con tuberías CI/CD y Azure Compute Gallery

title: The Art of Mac Malware
description:
Defenders must fully understand how malicious software works if they hope to stay ahead of the increasingly sophisticated threats facing Apple products today. The Art of Mac Malware: The Guide to Analyzing Malicious Software is a comprehensive handbook to cracking open these malicious programs and seeing what's inside.

Discover the secrets of nation state backdoors, destructive ransomware, and subversive cryptocurrency miners as you uncover their infection methods, persistence strategies, and insidious capabilities. Then work with and extend foundational reverse-engineering tools to extract and decrypt embedded strings, unpack protected Mach-O malware, and even reconstruct binary code. Next, using a debugger, you'll execute the malware, instruction by instruction, to discover exactly how it operates. In the book's final section, youll put these lessons into practice by analyzing a complex Mac malware specimen on your own.

Youll learn to:

Recognize common infections vectors, persistence mechanisms, and payloads leveraged by Mac malwareTriage unknown samples in order to quickly classify them as benign or maliciousWork with static analysis tools, including disassemblers, in order to study malicious scripts and compiled binariesLeverage dynamical analysis tools, such as monitoring tools and debuggers, to gain further insight into sophisticated threatsQuickly identify and bypass anti-analysis techniques aimed at thwarting your analysis attempts

A former NSA hacker and current leader in the field of macOS threat analysis, Patrick Wardle uses real-world examples pulled from his original research. The Art of Mac Malware: The Guide to Analyzing Malicious Software is the definitive resource to battling these ever more prevalent and insidious Apple-focused threats.
translatedDescription:
Los defensores deben entender plenamente cómo funciona el software malicioso si esperan mantenerse por delante de las amenazas cada vez más sofisticadas que enfrentan los productos de Apple hoy. El arte de Mac Malware: La guía para analizar el software malicioso es un manual completo para abrir estos programas maliciosos y ver lo que hay dentro.

Descubre los secretos de los backdoors estatales de nación, ransomware destructivo y mineros de criptomoneda subversivos mientras descubres sus métodos de infección, estrategias de persistencia y capacidades insidiosas. A continuación, trabajar con y extender herramientas de ingeniería inversa fundamental para extraer y descifrar cadenas incrustadas, desempacar el malware Mach-O protegido, e incluso reconstruir código binario. A continuación, utilizando un depurador, ejecutará el malware, instrucción por instrucción, para descubrir exactamente cómo funciona. En la sección final del libro, pondrás estas lecciones en práctica analizando un complejo espécimen de malware Mac por tu cuenta.

Aprenderás a:

Reconocer los vectores de infecciones comunes, los mecanismos de persistencia y las cargas de pago aprovechadas por Mac malwareTriage muestras desconocidas para clasificarlas rápidamente como benignos o maliciososTrabajar con herramientas de análisis estáticos, incluyendo desmontadores, con el fin de estudiar scripts maliciosos y binarios compiladosLeverage dynamical analysis tools, such as monitoring tools and debuggers, to gain further insight into sofisticado threatsQuickly identify and bypass

Un antiguo hacker de la NSA y líder actual en el campo del análisis de amenazas macOS, Patrick Wardle utiliza ejemplos reales de su investigación original. El Arte de Mac Malware: La Guía para analizar el software malicioso es el recurso definitivo para combatir estas amenazas cada vez más frecuentes e insidiosas centradas en Apple.

title: Beginning Linux Programming, 4th Edition
description: Beginning Linux Programming, Fourth Edition continues its unique approach to teaching UNIX programming in a simple and structured way on the Linux platform. Through the use of detailed and realistic examples, students learn by doing, and are able to move from being a Linux beginner to creating custom applications in Linux. The book introduces fundamental concepts beginning with the basics of writing Unix programs in C, and including material on basic system calls, file I/O, interprocess communication (for getting programs to work together), and shell programming. Parallel to this, the book introduces the toolkits and libraries for working with user interfaces, from simpler terminal mode applications to X and GTK+ for graphical user interfaces. Advanced topics are covered in detail such as processes, pipes, semaphores, socket programming, using MySQL, writing applications for the GNOME or the KDE desktop, writing device drivers, POSIX Threads, and kernel programming for the latest Linux Kernel.
translatedDescription: Inicio de Linux Programming, Cuarta Edición continúa su enfoque único para enseñar la programación UNIX de manera sencilla y estructurada en la plataforma Linux. Mediante el uso de ejemplos detallados y realistas, los estudiantes aprenden haciendo y pueden pasar de ser un principiante de Linux a crear aplicaciones personalizadas en Linux. El libro introduce conceptos fundamentales comenzando con los fundamentos de la escritura de programas Unix en C, e incluyendo material sobre llamadas básicas del sistema, archivo I/O, comunicación interproceso (para conseguir programas para trabajar juntos), y programación de shell. Paralelamente a esto, el libro introduce los kits de herramientas y bibliotecas para trabajar con interfaces de usuario, desde aplicaciones de modo terminal más simples a X y GTK+ para interfaces gráficas de usuario. Los temas avanzados están cubiertos en detalle, como procesos, tuberías, semaforos, programación de tomas, utilizando MySQL, escribiendo aplicaciones para el GNOME o el escritorio KDE, escribiendo controladores de dispositivo, POSIX Threads y programación del núcleo para el último kernel de Linux.

title: How to Catch a Phish: A Practical Guide to Detecting Phishing Emails
description:
Learn how to detect, analyze, and respond to phishing emails, the top infection vector used by cybercriminals. The repeatable process described in this book has been cultivated and tested in real-life incidents and validated across multiple threat landscapes and environments.

Every organization and individual with an email account is susceptible to deceptive emails sent by attackers with nefarious intentions. This activity, known as phishing, involves an attacker attempting to lure individuals into providing sensitive information or performing a predetermined action. Attacks vary in sophistication, but the core skills and process to detect, analyze, and respond to a suspicious message does not change.

Attackers have preyed on victims with convincing and not-so-convincing phishing emails to gain initial footholds into networks around the world for over 30 years. This attack method has been rapidly growing in popularity and continues to be the number one method that organizations and individuals struggle to defend against. Regardless of what any vendor or organization will tell you, no infallible tool exists to eliminate this threat completely.

This book teaches you how to analyze suspicious messages using free tools and resources. You will understand the basics of email, tactics used by attackers, and a repeatable process to systematically analyze messages and respond to suspicious activity.

You Will Learn How to:

Safely save email messages as attachments for analysis
Identify what information is in an email header
Review header information and extract key indicators or patterns used for detection
Identify signs of a suspicious or malicious email message
Detect the tactics that attackers use in phishing emails
Safely examine email links and attachments
Use a variety of free and simple tools to analyze email messages

Who This Book Is For

Cybersecurity professionals and interested computer security enthusiasts currently holding or aspiring to obtain positions such as IT Security Analyst, Network Defender, Security Operations Center Analyst, or Help Desk Technician. Readers should have a general understanding of how email works and some ways that attackers use this platform for initial access.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a detectar, analizar y responder a correos electrónicos de phishing, el vector de infección superior utilizado por cibercriminales. El proceso repetible descrito en este libro ha sido cultivado y probado en incidentes reales y validado en múltiples paisajes y entornos de amenaza.

Cada organización e individuo con una cuenta de correo electrónico es susceptible a correos electrónicos engañosos enviados por los atacantes con intenciones nefastas. Esta actividad, conocida como phishing, involucra a un atacante que intenta atraer a individuos para proporcionar información sensible o realizar una acción predeterminada. Los ataques varían en la sofisticación, pero las habilidades básicas y el proceso para detectar, analizar y responder a un mensaje sospechoso no cambia.

Los atacantes se han negado a las víctimas con mensajes convincentes y no tan convincentes de phishing para ganar puntos iniciales en redes alrededor del mundo durante más de 30 años. Este método de ataque ha ido creciendo rápidamente en popularidad y sigue siendo el método número uno que las organizaciones y los individuos luchan por defender. Independientemente de lo que cualquier proveedor u organización le diga, no existe ninguna herramienta infalible para eliminar completamente esta amenaza.

Este libro te enseña a analizar mensajes sospechosos usando herramientas y recursos gratuitos. Usted comprenderá los fundamentos del correo electrónico, las tácticas utilizadas por los atacantes, y un proceso repetible para analizar sistemáticamente los mensajes y responder a la actividad sospechosa.

Aprenderás Cómo:

Guardar los mensajes de correo electrónico como archivos adjuntos para el análisis
Identificar la información en un encabezado de correo electrónico
Revise la información del encabezado y extraiga indicadores o patrones clave utilizados para la detección
Identificar signos de un mensaje de correo electrónico sospechoso o malicioso
Detectar las tácticas que los atacantes usan en correos electrónicos de phishing
Examinar con seguridad los enlaces de correo electrónico y los adjuntos
Utilice una variedad de herramientas gratuitas y sencillas para analizar mensajes de correo electrónico

Quién es este libro

Los profesionales de la ciberseguridad y los entusiastas de la seguridad informática interesados tienen o aspiran a obtener posiciones como el Analista de Seguridad de la TI, el Defensor de la Red, el Analista de Operaciones de Seguridad o el Técnico de Ayuda. Los lectores deben tener una comprensión general de cómo funciona el email y algunas maneras que los atacantes utilizan esta plataforma para el acceso inicial.

title: Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE 7 Cert Guide: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 (EX200 and EX300)
description:
Trust the best-selling Cert Guide series from Pearson IT Certification to help you learn, prepare, and practice for exam success. Cert Guides are built with the objective of providing assessment, review, and practice to help ensure you are fully prepared for your certification exam.

Master Red Hat RHCSA (EX200) and RHCE (EX300) exam topics

Assess your knowledge with chapter-opening quizzes
Review key concepts with exam preparation tasks
Test yourself with 4 practice exams (2 RHCSA and 2 RHCE)
Gain expertise and knowledge using the companion website, which contains over 40 interactive exercises, 4 advanced CLI simulations, 40 interactive quizzes and glossary quizzes (one for each chapter), 3 virtual machines and more.

Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE 7 Cert Guide presents you with an organized test preparation routine through the use of proven series elements and techniques. “Do I Know This Already?” quizzes open each chapter and allow you to decide how much time you need to spend on each section. Exam topic lists make referencing easy. Chapter-ending labs help you drill on key concepts you must know thoroughly.

Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE 7, Premium Edition eBook and Practice Test focuses specifically on the objectives for the newest Red Hat RHCSA (EX200) and RHCE (EX300) exams reflecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. Expert Linux trainer and consultant Sander van Vugt shares preparation hints and test-taking tips, helping you identify areas of weakness and improve both your conceptual knowledge and hands-on skills. Material is presented in a concise manner, focusing on increasing your understanding and retention of exam topics.

Well-regarded for its level of detail, assessment features, comprehensive design scenarios, and challenging review questions and exercises, this study guide helps you master the concepts and techniques that will allow you to succeed on the exam the first time.

This study guide helps you master all the topics on the new RHCSA (EX200) and RHCE (EX300) exams, including

Part 1: RHCSA

Basic System Management: Installation, tools, text files, server connections; user, group, and permissions management; network configuration
Operating Running Systems: Process management, VMs, package installation, task scheduling, logging, managing partitions and LVM logical volumes
Advanced System Administration: Basic kernel management, basic Apache server configuration, boot procedures/troubleshooting
Managing Network Services: Using Kickstart; managing SELinux; configuring firewalls, remote mounts, FTP, and time services

title: Optimizing Linux® Performance: A Hands-On Guide to Linux® Performance Tools
description:
The first comprehensive, expert guide for end-to-end Linux application optimization

Learn to choose the right tools—and use them together to solve real problems in real production environments

Superior application performance is more crucial than ever—and in today's complex production environments, it's tougher to ensure, too. If you use Linux, you have extraordinary advantages: complete source code access, plus an exceptional array of optimization tools. But the tools are scattered across the Internet. Many are poorly documented. And few experts know how to use them together to solve real problems. Now, one of those experts has written the definitive Linux tuning primer for every professional: Optimizing Linux® Performance.

Renowned Linux benchmarking specialist Phillip Ezolt introduces each of today's most important Linux optimization tools, showing how they fit into a proven methodology for perfecting overall application performance. Using realistic examples, Ezolt shows developers how to pinpoint exact lines of source code that are impacting performance. He teaches sysadmins and application developers how to rapidly drill down to specific bottlenecks, so they can implement solutions more quickly. You'll discover how to:

Identify bottlenecks even if you're not familiar with the underlying system

Find and choose the right performance tools for any problem

Recognize the meaning of the events you're measuring

Optimize system CPU, user CPU, memory, network I/O, and disk I/O—and understand their interrelationships

Fix CPU-bound, latency-sensitive, and I/O-bound applications, through case studies you can easily adapt to your own environment

Install and use oprofile, the advanced systemwide profiler for Linux systems

If you're new to tuning, Ezolt gives you a clear and practical introduction to all the principles and strategies you'll need. If you're migrating to Linux, you'll quickly master Linux equivalents to the tools and techniques you already know. Whatever your background or environment, this book can help you improve the performance of all your Linux applications—increasingbusiness value and user satisfaction at the same time.

© Copyright Pearson Education. All rights reserved.

Encontrar y elegir las herramientas de rendimiento adecuadas para cualquier problema

Optimize system CPU, usuario CPU, memoria, red I/O y disco I/O, y entender sus interrelaciones

Develop games in Lisp

Experienced programmers new to Lisp.

title: Using and Administering Linux: Volume 3: Zero to SysAdmin: Network Services
description:
In Using and Administering Linux: Volume 3 you’ll work with multiple VMs on a single physical host to create a network in which to sharpen your sysadmin skills. Chapters have been fully updated to Fedora Linux 38 with expanded content and figures as well brand new material on the BTRFS file system, using Zram for swap, NetworkManager, automation with Ansible, as well as systemd.

Focusing on network and other advanced services, this second edition of the final series volume builds upon the skills you have learned so far in volumes 1&2 and will depend upon the virtual network and VMs created there.  Start by reviewing the administration of Linux servers and install and configure various Linux server services such as DHCP, DNS, NTP, and SSH server that will be used to provide advanced network services. You’ll then learn to install and configure servers such as BIND for name services, DHCP for network host configuration, and SSH for secure logins to remote hosts. 

Other topics covered include public/private keypairs to further enhance security, SendMail and IMAP and antispam protection for email, using Apache and WordPress to create and manage web sites, NFS, SAMBA, and Chrony.  This volume also covers SELinux and its use in making your systems even more secure., You will learn to build RPMs to be used to distribute automation scripts.  All of these services are installed on a single server host over the course of the book and by the time you are finished you will have a single server that provides these services for your network.

What You Will Learn

Install, configure, and manage several Linux server services such as email with spam management and single and multiple web sites
Work with NTP time synchronization, DHCP, SSH, and file sharing with Unix/Linux and Windows clients
Create RPMs for distribution of scripts and administrative programs.
Understand and work withenhanced security.     

Who This Book Is For

Those who are already Linux power users – SysAdmins who can administer Linux workstation hosts that are not servers – who want to learn to administer the services provided by Linux servers such as web, time, name, email, SSH, and more.

Centrándose en la red y otros servicios avanzados, esta segunda edición del volumen final de la serie se basa en las habilidades que has aprendido hasta ahora en los volúmenes 1/32 y dependerá de la red virtual y los VM creados allí. Comience revisando la administración de servidores Linux e instalando y configurando varios servicios de servidores Linux como DHCP, DNS, NTP y SSH que se utilizarán para proporcionar servicios de red avanzados. Luego aprenderás a instalar y configurar servidores como BIND para servicios de nombres, DHCP para configuración de hosts de red y SSH para accesos seguros a hosts remotos.

Otros temas tratados incluyen teclados públicos/privados para mejorar aún más la seguridad, SendMail e IMAP y protección antispam para el correo electrónico, utilizando Apache y WordPress para crear y gestionar sitios web, NFS, SAMBA y Chrony. Este volumen también cubre SELinux y su uso en hacer sus sistemas aún más seguros., Usted aprenderá a construir RPMs para ser utilizado para distribuir scripts de automatización. Todos estos servicios se instalan en un servidor único durante el curso del libro y para el momento en que se termine tendrá un solo servidor que proporcione estos servicios para su red.

Qué aprenderás

Instalar, configurar y gestionar varios servicios de servidor de Linux como correo electrónico con gestión de spam y sitios web únicos y múltiples
Trabaja con sincronización de tiempo NTP, DHCP, SSH y compartir archivos con clientes de Unix/Linux y Windows
Crear RPMs para la distribución de scripts y programas administrativos.
Comprender y trabajar con seguridad mejorada.

Quién es este libro

Aquellos que ya son usuarios de energía Linux – SysAdmins que pueden administrar hosts de estaciones de trabajo Linux que no son servidores – que quieren aprender a administrar los servicios proporcionados por servidores Linux como web, tiempo, nombre, correo electrónico, SSH y más.

Cientos de ejemplos actualizados, más índices completos que ofrecen acceso instantáneo a respuestas que puedes confiar

Sobell te lleva a través de todas las características y técnicas esenciales, desde la instalación de Ubuntu a trabajar con GNOME, Samba, exim4, Apache, DNS, NIS, LDAP, gufw, firestarter, iptables, incluso Perl scripting. Encontrarás capítulos completos en el funcionamiento de Ubuntu desde la línea de comandos y el escritorio (GUI), administrando sistemas, estableciendo redes y servidores de Internet, y mucho más. Las secciones Fully updated JumpStart le ayudan a conseguir servidores complejos funcionando, a menudo en tan solo cinco minutos.

Sobell aprovecha su inmenso conocimiento de Linux para explicar tanto los “cómos” como los “por qué” de Ubuntu. Ha enseñado cientos de miles de lectores y nunca olvida lo que es ser nuevo en Linux. Ya sea usuario, administrador o programador, encontrará todo lo que necesita aquí, ahora y por muchos años.

El libro Ubuntu Linux más práctico del mundo es ahora aún más útil!

Este libro entrega

Cientos de ejemplos Ubuntu fáciles de usar

Importante cobertura de redes, incluyendo DNS, NFS y Cacti

cobertura más detallada y utilizable de la configuración del servidor de Internet, incluyendo servidores Apache (Web) y exim4 (email)

Técnicas de seguridad de última generación, incluyendo técnicas de instalación de cortafuegos actualizadas usando gufw e iptables, y un capítulo completo sobre OpenSSH

Una introducción completa al script Perl para administración automatizada

Cobertura más profunda de tareas esenciales de administración – desde la gestión de usuarios a impresión CUPS, configurando LANs para construir un núcleo

Instrucciones completas para mantener los sistemas Ubuntu actualizados usando aptitude, Synaptic y la ventana Fuentes de Software

Y mucho más... incluyendo un glosario de 500+

Incluye DVD! ¡Consigue la versión completa de Lucid Lynx, la última versión de Ubuntu LTS!

title: Pro Linux Embedded Systems
description: Modern embedded hardware is more sophisticated than ever: most systems include the capabilities found on desktop systems. This book is written from the perspective of a user employing technologies and techniques typically reserved for desktop systems.

title: Mastering Linux Kernel Development
description:
Delve into the inner workings of the Linux kernel with 'Mastering Linux Kernel Development.' This book explores the design and implementation of core kernel subsystems, providing you with a comprehensive understanding of this elegantly crafted open-source software. Gain insights into key kernel code, structures, and algorithms to grasp the true essence of kernel functionality.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the abstraction mechanisms of processes and files in the Linux kernel.
Master the essentials of memory management including both physical and virtual memory models.
Explore process scheduling techniques for improved system performance and capacity utilization.
Gain expertise in kernel synchronization and locking for effective SMP platform handling.
Comprehend interrupt and clock subsystem management for hardware event processing.

Author(s)

CH Raghav Maruthi is an experienced kernel developer and technical author committed to demystifying complex Linux kernel concepts. With profound expertise in operating systems and the Linux architecture, he blends hands-on insights with lucid explanations. His engaging writing brings clarity to even the most intricate topics.

Who is it for?

This book caters to kernel programmers eager to deepen their knowledge of kernel components and APIs. Perfect for readers with prior kernel programming familiarity looking to advance their expertise. Ideal for those wanting insight into kernel subsystem implementation. Empowers developers seeking refined skills in kernel development.

Obtenga información sobre código clave del núcleo, estructuras y algoritmos para captar la verdadera esencia de la funcionalidad del kernel.

Comprenda los mecanismos de abstracción de procesos y archivos en el núcleo Linux.
Domine los elementos esenciales de la gestión de memoria incluyendo tanto modelos de memoria física como virtual.
Explore las técnicas de programación de procesos para mejorar el rendimiento del sistema y la utilización de la capacidad.

title: SELinux Cookbook
description:
SELinux Cookbook is your go-to guide to mastering the SELinux framework on your Linux systems. With a collection of over 70 hands-on recipes, you will gain the skills to configure, fine-tune, and troubleshoot SELinux policies tailored to your system's needs. Each recipe is designed to teach concepts step-by-step, making it an excellent resource to deepen your SELinux knowledge.

What this Book will help me do

Learn how to set up and prepare an environment for developing and testing SELinux policies.
Understand how to label files and manage security contexts to control access effectively.
Discover methods to confine applications, including web servers and desktop apps, with tailored SELinux policies.
Explore ways to debug and troubleshoot SELinux issues to maintain secure and functional environments.
Gain insights into aligning SELinux with traditional access controls and handling SELinux-aware applications.

Author(s)

Sven Vermeulen is an experienced Linux system administrator and a long-time contributor to open-source projects. With an in-depth understanding of SELinux, he has been instrumental in promoting secure computing practices. Sven brings a unique combination of theoretical knowledge and practical skills, ensuring readers not only learn core concepts but also how to apply them effectively.

Who is it for?

SELinux Cookbook is perfect for Linux system administrators or service administrators seeking to master SELinux. If you are familiar with SELinux-enabled systems and want to customize and apply SELinux policies to enhance security, you will find this book invaluable. It offers practical examples and real-world scenarios suitable for users looking to gain hands-on experience. Intermediate Linux knowledge is recommended for the best experience with this guide.

"Mastering Linux Security and Hardening" is a comprehensive guide designed to help you effectively secure Linux environments. By exploring real-world scenarios and implementing advanced techniques, you will learn how to protect your systems from potential threats. Discover how to harden your system to meet stringent security standards and ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and availability.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and implement robust techniques to protect Linux systems from unauthorized access.
Master network service detection and secure configuration to reduce vulnerabilities.
Effectively use discretionary and mandatory access controls to enhance file system security.
Discover how to harden SSH and encrypt network communication for secure data transfers.
Learn real-world strategies and tools to audit, detect, and deter intrusion attempts.

Author(s)

Donald A. Tevault is a seasoned Linux security expert with years of practical experience helping organizations safeguard their systems. His approach combines technical depth with usability, ensuring his readers can apply their learning effectively. Donald has a proven track record in Linux-based environments and shares his expertise in a structured and approachable way.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for systems administrators, network engineers, and IT security consultants who want to enhance their Linux security expertise. It is particularly useful for professionals already familiar with Linux fundamentals looking to deepen their abilities. The content is geared toward those seeking to proactively protect their systems against prevalent security threats. With clear practical examples, it supports learners in taking their Linux security skills to the next level.

title: Ransomware Revealed: A Beginner’s Guide to Protecting and Recovering from Ransomware Attacks
description:
Know how to mitigate and handle ransomware attacks via the essential cybersecurity training in this book so you can stop attacks before they happen. Learn the types of ransomware, distribution methods, internal structure, families (variants), defense strategies, recovery methods, and legal issues related to reporting ransomware incidents to authorities and other affected parties. This book also teaches you how to develop a ransomware incident response plan to minimize ransomware damage and recover normal operations quickly.

Ransomware is a category of malware that can encrypt your computer and mobile device files until you pay a ransom to unlock them. Ransomware attacks are considered the most prevalent cybersecurity threats today—the number of new ransomware variants has grown 30-fold since 2015 and they currently account for roughly 40% of all spam messages. Attacks have increased in occurrence from one every 40 seconds to one every 14 seconds. Government and private corporations are targets. Despite the security controls set by organizations to protect their digital assets, ransomware is still dominating the world of security and will continue to do so in the future.

Ransomware Revealeddiscusses the steps to follow if a ransomware infection occurs, such as how to pay the ransom through anonymous payment methods, perform a backup and restore your affected files, and search online to find a decryption tool to unlock (decrypt) your files for free. Mitigation steps are discussed in depth for both endpoint devices and network systems.

What You Will Learn

Be aware of how ransomware infects your system
Comprehend ransomware components in simple terms
Recognize the different types of ransomware families
Identify the attack vectors employed by ransomware to infect computer systems
Know how to prevent ransomware attacks from successfully comprising your system and network (i.e., mitigation strategies)
Know what to do if a successful ransomware infection takes place
Understand how to pay the ransom as well as the pros and cons of paying
Set up a ransomware response plan to recover from such attacks

Who This Book Is For

Those who do not specialize in the cybersecurity field (but have adequate IT skills) and want to fully understand the anatomy of ransomware threats. Although most of the book's content will be understood by ordinary computer users, it will also prove useful for experienced IT users aiming to understand the ins and outs of ransomware threats without diving deep into the technical jargon of the internal structure of ransomware.
