Este libro también le enseña cómo desarrollar un plan de respuesta de incidentes ransomware para minimizar el daño ransomware y recuperar operaciones normales rápidamente.

Ransomware es una categoría de malware que puede encriptar los archivos de ordenador y dispositivo móvil hasta que pague un rescate para desbloquearlos. Los ataques de Ransomware se consideran las amenazas de ciberseguridad más frecuentes hoy en día: el número de nuevas variantes de ransomware ha crecido 30 veces desde 2015 y actualmente representan aproximadamente el 40% de todos los mensajes de spam. Los ataques han aumentado en ocurrencia de uno cada 40 segundos a uno cada 14 segundos. El Gobierno y las empresas privadas son objetivos. Despite the security controls set by organizations to protect their digital assets, ransomware is still dominating the world of security and will continue to do so in the future.

Ransomware Revealeddiscute los pasos a seguir si se produce una infección ransomware, como cómo pagar el rescate mediante métodos de pago anónimos, realizar una copia de seguridad y restaurar los archivos afectados, y buscar en línea para encontrar una herramienta de descifrado para desbloquear (descifrar) sus archivos de forma gratuita. Los pasos de mitigación se examinan en profundidad tanto para dispositivos endpoint como para sistemas de red.

Qué aprenderás

Tenga en cuenta cómo el ransomware infecta su sistema
Compuestos de ransomware en términos simples
Reconocer los diferentes tipos de familias ransomware
Identificar los vectores de ataque empleados por ransomware para infectar sistemas informáticos
Saber cómo evitar los ataques ransomware que compliquen con éxito su sistema y red (es decir, estrategias de mitigación)
Saber qué hacer si se produce una infección ransomware exitosa
Entender cómo pagar el rescate, así como los pros y contras de pagar
Establecer un plan de respuesta de ransomware para recuperarse de tales ataques

Quién es este libro

Aquellos que no se especializan en el campo de la ciberseguridad (pero tienen habilidades informáticas adecuadas) y quieren comprender plenamente la anatomía de amenazas ransomware. Aunque la mayor parte del contenido del libro será comprendido por los usuarios ordinarios de computadoras, también resultará útil para los usuarios experimentados de TI que pretenden comprender las ins y salidas de amenazas ransomware sin bucear profundamente en la jerga técnica de la estructura interna de ransomware.

title: Running Linux, 5th Edition
description:
You may be contemplating your first Linux installation. Or you may have been using Linux for years and need to know more about adding a network printer or setting up an FTP server. Running Linux, now in its fifth edition, is the book you'll want on hand in either case. Widely recognized in the Linux community as the ultimate getting-started and problem-solving book, it answers the questions and tackles the configuration issues that frequently plague users, but are seldom addressed in other books.

This fifth edition of Running Linux is greatly expanded, reflecting the maturity of the operating system and the teeming wealth of software available for it. Hot consumer topics suchas audio and video playback applications, groupware functionality, and spam filtering are covered, along with the basics in configuration and management that always have made the book popular.

Running Linux covers basic communications such as mail, web surfing, and instant messaging, but also delves into the subtleties of network configuration--including dial-up, ADSL, and cable modems--in case you need to set up your network manually. The book canmake you proficient on office suites and personal productivity applications--and also tells you what programming tools are available if you're interested in contributing to these applications.

Other new topics in the fifth edition include encrypted email and filesystems, advanced shell techniques, and remote login applications. Classic discussions on booting, package management, kernel recompilation, and X configuration have also been updated.

The authors of Running Linux have anticipated problem areas, selected stable and popular solutions, and provided clear instructions to ensure that you'll have a satisfying experience using Linux. The discussion is direct and complete enough to guide novice users, while still providing the additional information experienced users will need to progress in their mastery of Linux.

Whether you're using Linux on a home workstation or maintaining a network server, Running Linux will provide expert advice just when you need it.

Ya sea que esté usando Linux en una estación de trabajo en casa o manteniendo un servidor de red, Running Linux proporcionará asesoramiento experto justo cuando lo necesite.

title: Red Hat RHCSA 8 Cert Guide: EX200, 2nd Edition
description:
Learn, prepare, and practice for Red Hat RHCSA 8 (EX200) exam success with this Cert Guide from Pearson IT Certification, a leader in IT Certification learning.

* Master Red Hat RHCSA 8 EX200 exam topics

* Assess your knowledge with chapter-ending quizzes and labs

Chapter-ending Exam Preparation Tasks help you drill on key concepts you must know thoroughly. El asesor líder de Linux, autor e instructor Sander van Vugt comparte consejos de preparación y toma de pruebas, ayudándole a identificar áreas de debilidad y mejorar sus conocimientos conceptuales y habilidades prácticas. El material se presenta de manera concisa, centrándose en aumentar su comprensión y retención de temas de examen.

El libro le presenta una rutina organizada de preparación de pruebas a través del uso de elementos y técnicas de serie comprobados. Las listas de temas de examen facilitan la referencia. Preparación del examen final del capítulo Las tareas te ayudan a perforar conceptos clave que debes saber a fondo. Las preguntas de revisión le ayudan a evaluar su conocimiento, y un capítulo de preparación final le guía a través de herramientas y recursos para ayudarle a elaborar su plan de estudio final.

El sitio web de acompañantes también contiene dos pruebas de práctica adicionales más dos horas completas de formación de vídeo personal de los autores Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) Full Video Course, 3rd Edition.

Bien considerado por su nivel de detalle, características de evaluación y preguntas y ejercicios de revisión desafiantes, esta guía de estudio le ayuda a dominar los conceptos y técnicas que le permitirán tener éxito en el examen por primera vez, incluyendo

* Gestión básica del sistema: Instalación, herramientas, gestión de archivos, archivos de texto, conexiones RHEL8, gestión de usuarios/grupos, permisos y configuración de red

* Sistemas de funcionamiento operativos: Gestión de software, procesos, almacenamiento y almacenamiento avanzado; trabajo con Systemd; tareas de programación; y configuración de registro

* Administración avanzada del sistema: Gestión del núcleo y los procedimientos de arranque, solución de problemas esenciales, script de bash shell

* Gestión de servicios de red: Configuración de SSH, cortafuegos y servicios de tiempo; gestión de servicios Apache HTTP y SE Linux; acceso al almacenamiento de red; y gestión de contenedores..

title: Practical Linux Security Cookbook - Second Edition
description:
The "Practical Linux Security Cookbook" offers a robust guide for system administrators and IT specialists looking to secure their Linux systems against contemporary threats. By following practical and actionable recipes in this book, you will learn how to assess vulnerabilities, mitigate risks, and ensure your systems remain secure and resilient.

What this Book will help me do

Understand common vulnerabilities in Linux systems and the tools to manage them.
Customize the Linux kernel for optimal and secure performance.
Implement secure methods for local and remote authentication of users.
Utilize effective network security practices and tools to protect Linux systems.
Conduct regular scanning, auditing, and monitoring to maintain a secure Linux environment.

Author(s)

None Kalsi is an author with deep expertise in Linux administration and system security. With years of professional experience securing diverse Linux environments, he applies a hands-on approach to guide readers. His clear and concise way to explain complex security concepts makes his work accessible and practical for readers.

Who is it for?

The book is aimed at Linux administrators and users with basic command-line knowledge who want to enhance the security of their systems. It's perfect for those familiar with Linux who wish to understand security risks and implement best practices. If you are responsible for managing Linux environments and aim to protect them against vulnerabilities, this book is for you. No prior expert security knowledge is required, just a willingness to learn.
translatedDescription:
El "Practical Linux Security Cookbook" ofrece una guía robusta para administradores de sistemas y especialistas en TI que buscan asegurar sus sistemas Linux contra amenazas contemporáneas. Al seguir recetas prácticas y factibles en este libro, usted aprenderá a evaluar vulnerabilidades, mitigar riesgos y asegurar que sus sistemas permanezcan seguros y resistentes.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender vulnerabilidades comunes en los sistemas Linux y las herramientas para gestionarlos.
Personalizar el kernel de Linux para un rendimiento óptimo y seguro.
Implementar métodos seguros para la autenticación local y remota de los usuarios.
Utilizar prácticas y herramientas de seguridad de red eficaces para proteger los sistemas Linux.
Realizar análisis regulares, auditorías y monitoreo para mantener un entorno Linux seguro.

Autor(s)

Ninguno Kalsi es un autor con profunda experiencia en administración de Linux y seguridad del sistema. Con años de experiencia profesional asegurando diversos entornos Linux, aplica un enfoque práctico para guiar a los lectores. Su forma clara y concisa de explicar conceptos complejos de seguridad hace que su trabajo sea accesible y práctico para los lectores.

¿Para quién es?

El libro está dirigido a administradores y usuarios de Linux con conocimientos básicos de línea de comandos que quieren mejorar la seguridad de sus sistemas. Es perfecto para aquellos familiarizados con Linux que desean entender los riesgos de seguridad e implementar las mejores prácticas. Si usted es responsable de gestionar entornos Linux y pretende protegerlos contra vulnerabilidades, este libro es para usted. No se requiere ningún conocimiento de seguridad experto previo, sólo una disposición para aprender.

title: Linux Administration Best Practices
description:
"Linux Administration Best Practices" offers a comprehensive guide to mastering Linux system administration by focusing on foundational concepts and best practices. You'll learn to understand the strategic decision-making behind effective system management, moving beyond troubleshooting tasks to aligning Linux systems with business goals efficiently.

What this Book will help me do

Understand core roles and responsibilities of a Linux system administrator.
Learn strategies for effective risk assessment and administration decisions.
Master approaches to managing backups and disaster recovery processes.
Implement best practices for Linux-specific system configurations.
Enhance troubleshooting skills with effective practices to resolve issues proactively.

Author(s)

Scott Alan Miller possesses years of expertise working with Linux systems as a system administrator and engineer. His practical knowledge combines with a thoughtful approach to explaining concepts clearly. Scott emphasizes understanding systemic reasons behind systems management, helping readers think like experts.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for established administrators wishing to refine their expertise, beginners aiming to move into professional administration roles, or IT professionals looking for a comprehensive overview of effective Linux system management. Readers should have basic familiarity with Linux and desire to deepen their systemic knowledge.
translatedDescription:
"Linux Administration Best Practices" ofrece una guía integral para dominar la administración del sistema Linux centrándose en conceptos fundacionales y mejores prácticas. Aprenderás a entender la toma de decisiones estratégicas detrás de una gestión eficaz del sistema, pasando más allá de tareas de solución de problemas para alinear los sistemas Linux con objetivos empresariales eficientemente.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender los roles y responsabilidades fundamentales de un administrador del sistema Linux.
Aprende estrategias para la evaluación efectiva del riesgo y decisiones administrativas.
Principales enfoques para la gestión de respaldos y procesos de recuperación en casos de desastre.
Implementar mejores prácticas para configuraciones de sistemas específicas para Linux.
Mejorar las habilidades de solución de problemas con prácticas eficaces para resolver las cuestiones proactivamente.

Autor(s)

Scott Alan Miller posee años de experiencia trabajando con sistemas Linux como administrador e ingeniero del sistema. Su conocimiento práctico se combina con un enfoque reflexivo para explicar claramente los conceptos. Scott enfatiza entender las razones sistémicas detrás de la gestión de sistemas, ayudando a los lectores a pensar como expertos.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es perfecto para administradores establecidos que deseen refinar su experiencia, principiantes con el objetivo de entrar en funciones de administración profesional, o profesionales de TI que buscan una visión completa de la gestión eficaz del sistema Linux. Los lectores deben tener familiaridad básica con Linux y deseo de profundizar su conocimiento sistémico.

title: Ransomware
description:
The biggest online threat to businesses and consumers today is ransomware, a category of malware that can encrypt your computer files until you pay a ransom to unlock them. With this practical book, you’ll learn how easily ransomware infects your system and what steps you can take to stop the attack before it sets foot in the network.

Security experts Allan Liska and Timothy Gallo explain how the success of these attacks has spawned not only several variants of ransomware, but also a litany of ever-changing ways they’re delivered to targets. You’ll learn pragmatic methods for responding quickly to a ransomware attack, as well as how to protect yourself from becoming infected in the first place.

Learn how ransomware enters your system and encrypts your files
Understand why ransomware use has grown, especially in recent years
Examine the organizations behind ransomware and the victims they target
Learn how wannabe hackers use Ransomware as a Service (RaaS) to launch campaigns
Understand how ransom is paid—and the pros and cons of paying
Use methods to protect your organization’s workstations and servers
translatedDescription:
La mayor amenaza en línea para empresas y consumidores de hoy es ransomware, una categoría de malware que puede cifrar sus archivos de computadora hasta que usted paga un rescate para desbloquearlos. Con este libro práctico, usted aprenderá lo fácil que el ransomware infecta su sistema y qué pasos puede tomar para detener el ataque antes de que se ponga pie en la red.

Los expertos en seguridad Allan Liska y Timothy Gallo explican cómo el éxito de estos ataques ha generado no sólo varias variantes de ransomware, sino también una letanía de maneras siempre cambiantes que se entregan a objetivos. Aprenderás métodos pragmáticos para responder rápidamente a un ataque de ransomware, así como cómo protegerte de infectarte en primer lugar.

Aprende cómo ransomware entra en tu sistema y encripta tus archivos
Comprende por qué el uso de ransomware ha crecido, especialmente en los últimos años
Examinar las organizaciones detrás de ransomware y las víctimas a las que se dirigen
Aprende cómo los hackers utilizan Ransomware como un servicio (RaaS) para lanzar campañas
Comprender cómo se paga el rescate, y los pros y contras de pagar
Utilice métodos para proteger las estaciones de trabajo y servidores de su organización

title: Discrete Structures, Logic, and Computability, 4th Edition
description: Following the recent updates to the 2013 ACM/IEEE Computer Science curricula, Discrete Structures, Logic, and Computability, Fourth Edition, has been designed for the discrete math course that covers one to two semesters. Dr. Hein presents material in a spiral medthod of learning, introducing basic information about a topic, allowing the students to work on the problem and revisit the topic, as new information and skills are established. Written for prospective computer scientist, computer engineers, or applied mathematicians, who want to learn about the ideas that inspire computer science, this edition contains an extensive coverage of logic, setting it apart from similar books available in the field of Computer Science.
translatedDescription: Tras las recientes actualizaciones de los planes de estudio ACM/IEEE Computer Science 2013, Discrete Structures, Logic y Computability, Fourth Edition, se ha diseñado para el discreto curso de matemáticas que cubre uno a dos semestres. El Dr. Hein presenta material en un método espiral de aprendizaje, introduciendo información básica sobre un tema, permitiendo a los estudiantes trabajar sobre el problema y revisitar el tema, ya que se establecen nuevas informaciones y habilidades. Escrito para futuros científicos informáticos, ingenieros informáticos o matemáticos aplicados, que quieren aprender sobre las ideas que inspiran la ciencia informática, esta edición contiene una amplia cobertura de la lógica, diferenciando los libros similares disponibles en el campo de la Ciencia de la Computación.

title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 Administration: Real World Skills for Red Hat Administrators
description:
The definitive guide to administering a Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 network

Linux professionals who need a go-to guide on version 6 of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) will find what they need in this comprehensive Sybex book. It covers RHEL administration in detail, including how to set up and manage web and mail services, use RHEL in enterprise environments, secure it, optimize storage, configure for virtualization and high availability, and much more. It also provides a great study aid for those preparing for either the RHCSA or RHCE certification exam.

Red Hat is the Linux market leader, and Red Hat administrators are in demand

This Sybex guide is a comprehensive resource on Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration and useful for those preparing for one of the Red Hat certification exams

Covers setting up and managing web and mail services, using RHEL in enterprise environments, securing RHEL, and optimizing storage to fit your environment

Explores advanced RHEL configurations, including virtualization and high availability

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 Administration is the guide Linux professionals and Red Hat administrators need to stay current on the newest version.
translatedDescription:
La guía definitiva para administrar una red Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6

Los profesionales de Linux que necesitan una guía en la versión 6 de Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) encontrarán lo que necesitan en este completo libro Sybex. Cubre en detalle la administración de RHEL, incluyendo cómo configurar y gestionar servicios web y correo, utilizar RHEL en entornos empresariales, asegurarlo, optimizar el almacenamiento, configurar para la virtualización y alta disponibilidad, y mucho más. También proporciona una gran ayuda de estudio para aquellos que se preparan para el examen de certificación RHCSA o RHCE.

Red Hat es el líder del mercado de Linux, y los administradores de Red Hat están en demanda

Esta guía Sybex es un recurso integral en la administración de Red Hat Enterprise Linux y útil para aquellos que se preparan para uno de los exámenes de certificación Red Hat

Cubre la configuración y gestión de servicios web y correo, utilizando RHEL en entornos empresariales, asegurando RHEL y optimizando el almacenamiento para adaptarse a su entorno

Explora configuraciones avanzadas de RHEL, incluyendo virtualización y alta disponibilidad

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 Administración es la guía Los profesionales de Linux y los administradores de Red Hat necesitan mantenerse actualizados en la versión más reciente.

title: Performance Tuning for Linux® Servers
description:
Proven techniques for optimizing web, file, print, database, and application servers

Practical introductions to open source performance management tools

Easy-to-understand examples based on Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Novell SUSE Linux Enterprise Server

An indispensable guide to maximizing Linux system and application performance

From Wall Street to Hollywood, Linux runs many of the world's most businesscritical systems. Linux performance now impacts the entire enterprise. In Performance Tuning for Linux Servers, a team of IBM's most-experienced Linux performance specialists shows you how to find bottlenecks, measure performance, and identify effective optimizations.

This book doesn't just cover kernel tuning: it shows how to maximize the end-to-end performance of real-world applications and databases running on Linux. Throughout, the authors present realistic examples based on today's most popular enterprise Linux platforms, Intel-based Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and Novell SUSE Linux Enterprise Server. These examples are designed for simplicity, clarity, and easy adaptation to any contemporary Linux environment. You'll discover how to

Install and configure Linux for maximum performance from the outset

Evaluate and choose the right hardware architecture for your Linux environment

Understand Linux kernels 2.4 through 2.6: components, performance issues, and optimization opportunities

Master core Linux performance tuning principles and strategies

Utilize free, open source tools for measurement, monitoring, system tracing, and benchmarking

Interpret performance data to analyze your Linux server's real-world behavior

Optimize Linux system schedulers, memory, I/O, file systems, and networking

Tune web, file, database, and application servers running commercial workloads

Predict the impact of changes in tuning parameters or configurations

Tune Linux code: optimize design, timing, sockets, threads, synchronization, and more

Architect for maximum performance: SMP scaling, clustering, and topology

Integrate kernel and application tuning in end-to-end system optimization projects

Whether you're an administrator, developer, integrator, or consultant, Performance Tuning for Linux Serverswill help you maximize the performance and value of every Linux system and application you run.

© Copyright Pearson Education. All rights reserved.
translatedDescription:
Técnicas probadas para optimizar servidores web, archivo, impresión, base de datos y aplicaciones

Introducción práctica a los instrumentos de gestión del rendimiento de código abierto

Ejemplos fáciles de entender basados en Red Hat Enterprise Linux y Novell SUSE Linux Enterprise Server

Una guía indispensable para maximizar el sistema Linux y el rendimiento de aplicaciones

Desde Wall Street a Hollywood, Linux dirige muchos de los sistemas más críticos del mundo. El rendimiento de Linux ahora impacta a toda la empresa. En Performance Tuning para Linux Servers, un equipo de especialistas de rendimiento Linux más experimentados de IBM le muestra cómo encontrar obstáculos, medir el rendimiento e identificar optimizaciones eficaces.

Este libro no solo cubre el ajuste del kernel: muestra cómo maximizar el rendimiento de extremo a extremo de las aplicaciones y bases de datos del mundo real que se ejecutan en Linux. A lo largo de todo, los autores presentan ejemplos realistas basados en las plataformas Linux empresariales más populares de hoy, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, y Novell SUSE Linux Enterprise Server. Estos ejemplos están diseñados para la simplicidad, claridad y fácil adaptación a cualquier entorno Linux contemporáneo. Usted descubrirá cómo

Instalar y configurar Linux para el máximo rendimiento desde el inicio

Evaluar y elegir la arquitectura de hardware adecuada para su entorno Linux

Entender los kernels de Linux 2.4 a 2.6: componentes, problemas de rendimiento y oportunidades de optimización

Principales principios y estrategias de ajuste de rendimiento de Linux

Utilizar herramientas libres de código abierto para la medición, monitoreo, localización de sistemas y parámetros de referencia

Interpretar datos de rendimiento para analizar el comportamiento del mundo real de su servidor Linux

Optimize Linux system schedulers, Memory, I/O, file systems, and networking

Tune web, archivos, bases de datos y servidores de aplicaciones que ejecutan cargas de trabajo comerciales

Predecir el impacto de los cambios en los parámetros o configuraciones de ajuste

Tune Código Linux: optimizar diseño, tiempo, tomas, hilos, sincronización y más

Arquitecto para el máximo rendimiento: escalada SMP, agrupación y topología

Integrar el núcleo y el ajuste de aplicaciones en proyectos de optimización del sistema de extremo a extremo

Ya sea administrador, desarrollador, integrador o consultor, Performance Tuning para Linux Servers le ayudará a maximizar el rendimiento y el valor de cada sistema Linux y su aplicación.

© Copyright Pearson Education. Todos los derechos reservados.

title: Linux Appliance Design
description:
Modern appliances are complex machines with processors, operating systems, and application software. While there are books that will tell you how to run Linux on embedded hardware, and books on how to build a Linux application, Linux Appliance Design is the first book to demonstrate how to merge the two and create a Linux appliance. You'll see for yourself why Linux is the embedded operating system of choice for low-cost development and a fast time to market. Linux Appliance Design shows how to build better appliances-appliances with more types of interfaces, more dynamic interfaces, and better debugged interfaces. You'll learn how to build backend daemons, handle asynchronous events, and connect various user interfaces (including web, framebuffers, infrared control, SNMP, and front panels) to these processes for remote configuration and control. Linux Appliance Design also introduces the Run-Time Access library, which provides a uniform mechanism for user interfaces to communicate with daemons.

Learn to:

Separate your user interfaces from your daemons

Give user interfaces run time access to configuration, status, and statistics

Add professional network management capabilities to your application

Use SNMP and build a MIB

Build a web-based appliance interface

Build a command line interface (CLI)

Build a framebuffer interface with an infrared control as input

Manage logs and alarms on an appliance

Companion CD includes a prototype appliance-a home alarm system-that supports the book's lessons.
translatedDescription:
Los aparatos modernos son máquinas complejas con procesadores, sistemas operativos y software de aplicaciones. Mientras hay libros que le dirán cómo ejecutar Linux en hardware integrado, y libros sobre cómo construir una aplicación Linux, Linux Appliance Design es el primer libro que demuestra cómo fusionar los dos y crear un dispositivo Linux. Usted verá por sí mismo por qué Linux es el sistema operativo integrado de elección para el desarrollo de bajo costo y un tiempo rápido para el mercado. Linux Appliance Design muestra cómo construir mejores aplicaciones de electrodomésticos con más tipos de interfaces, interfaces más dinámicas y interfaces mejor depuradas. Aprenderás a construir daemons backend, manejar eventos asincrónicos y conectar varias interfaces de usuario (incluyendo web, framebuffers, control infrarrojo, SNMP y paneles frontales) a estos procesos para configuración y control remoto. Linux Appliance Design también introduce la biblioteca Run-Time Access, que proporciona un mecanismo uniforme para las interfaces de usuario para comunicarse con los daemons.

Aprende a:

Separa tus interfaces de usuario desde tus daemons

Dar acceso a la configuración, estado y estadísticas a las interfaces de usuario

Añadir capacidades profesionales de gestión de red a su aplicación

Use SNMP y construya un MIB

Construir una interfaz basada en la web

Construir una interfaz de línea de comandos (CLI)

Construir una interfaz de framebuffer con un control infrarrojo como entrada

Gestionar registros y alarmas en un dispositivo

Companion CD incluye un prototipo appliance-un sistema de alarma casera-que soporta las lecciones del libro.

title: Advanced Linux Programming
description: Advanced Linux Programming is divided into two parts. The first covers generic UNIX system services, but with a particular eye towards Linux specific information. This portion of the book will be of use even to advanced programmers who have worked with other Linux systems since it will cover Linux specific details and differences. For programmers without UNIX experience, it will be even more valuable. The second section covers material that is entirely Linux specific. These are truly advanced topics, and are the techniques that the gurus use to build great applications. While this book will focus mostly on the Application Programming Interface (API) provided by the Linux kernel and the C library, a preliminary introduction to the development tools available will allow all who purchase the book to make immediate use of Linux.
translatedDescription: Programación avanzada de Linux se divide en dos partes. La primera cubre los servicios genéricos del sistema UNIX, pero con un ojo particular hacia la información específica de Linux. Esta parte del libro será de uso incluso para los programadores avanzados que han trabajado con otros sistemas Linux ya que cubrirá detalles y diferencias específicos de Linux. Para los programadores sin experiencia UNIX, será aún más valioso. La segunda sección cubre material totalmente específico de Linux. Estos son temas realmente avanzados, y son las técnicas que el gurus utiliza para construir grandes aplicaciones. Si bien este libro se centrará principalmente en la interfaz de programación de aplicaciones (API) proporcionada por el kernel de Linux y la biblioteca C, una introducción preliminar a las herramientas de desarrollo disponibles permitirá a todos los que compran el libro para hacer uso inmediato de Linux.

title: Linux Kernel Development, Second Edition
description: The Linux kernel is one of the most important and far-reaching open-source projects. That is why Novell Press is excited to bring you the second edition of Linux Kernel Development, Robert Love's widely acclaimed insider's look at the Linux kernel. This authoritative, practical guide helps developers better understand the Linux kernel through updated coverage of all the major subsystems as well as new features associated with the Linux 2.6 kernel. You'll be able to take an in-depth look at Linux kernel from both a theoretical and an applied perspective as you cover a wide range of topics, including algorithms, system call interface, paging strategies and kernel synchronization. Get the top information right from the source in Linux Kernel Development.
translatedDescription: El núcleo Linux es uno de los proyectos de código abierto más importantes y de largo alcance. Es por eso que Novell Press está emocionado de traerle la segunda edición de Linux Kernel Development, la mirada de Robert Love ampliamente aclamada en el núcleo Linux. Esta guía práctica autorizada ayuda a los desarrolladores a comprender mejor el kernel de Linux mediante la cobertura actualizada de todos los subsistemas principales, así como nuevas características asociadas con el kernel Linux 2.6. Podrás echar un vistazo en profundidad al kernel de Linux desde una perspectiva teórica y aplicada mientras cubres una amplia gama de temas, incluyendo algoritmos, interfaz de llamada del sistema, estrategias de paging y sincronización del núcleo. Obtenga la información superior de la fuente en Linux Kernel Development.

title: Red Hat and IT Security: With Red Hat Ansible, Red Hat OpenShift, and Red Hat Security Auditing
description:
Use Red Hat’s security tools to establish a set of security strategies that work together to help protect your digital data. You will begin with the basic concepts of IT security and DevOps with topics such as CIA triage, security standards, network and system security controls and configuration, hybrid cloud infrastructure security, and the CI/CD process. Next, you will integrate and automate security into the DevOps cycle, infrastructure, and security as code. You will also learn how to automate with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform and about hybrid cloud infrastructure.

The later chapters will cover hyper-converged infrastructure and its security, Red Hat Smart Management, predictive analytics with Red Hat Insights, and Red Hat security auditing to ensure best security practices. Lastly, you will see the different types of case studies with real-world examples.

Red Hat and IT Security will help you get a better understanding of IT security concepts from a network and system administration perspective. It will help you to understand how the IT infrastructure landscape can change by implementing specific security best practices and integrating Red Hat products and solutions to counter against modern cybersecurity threats.

What You Will Learn

●        Understand IT infrastructure security and its best practices

●        Implement hybrid cloud infrastructure

●        Realign DevOps process into DevSecOps, emphasizing security

●        Implement automation in IT infrastructure services using Red Hat Ansible

●        Explore Red Hat Smart Management, predictive analytics, and auditing

Who This Book Is For

IT professionals handling network/system administration or the IT infrastructure of an organization. DevOps professionals and cybersecurity analysts would find the book useful.
translatedDescription:
Utilice las herramientas de seguridad de Red Hat para establecer un conjunto de estrategias de seguridad que trabajan juntas para ayudar a proteger sus datos digitales. Comenzarás con los conceptos básicos de seguridad informática y DevOps con temas como triage de la CIA, estándares de seguridad, controles de seguridad de red y sistema y configuración, seguridad de infraestructura de nube híbrida, y el proceso CI/CD. A continuación, integrará y automatizará la seguridad en el ciclo DevOps, infraestructura y seguridad como código. También aprenderá a automatizar con Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform y sobre infraestructura de nube híbrida.

Los capítulos posteriores cubrirán la infraestructura hiperconvergente y su seguridad, Red Hat Smart Management, analítica predictiva con Red Hat Insights y auditoría de seguridad Red Hat para asegurar mejores prácticas de seguridad. Por último, verás los diferentes tipos de estudios de casos con ejemplos del mundo real.

Red Hat y IT Security le ayudarán a obtener una mejor comprensión de los conceptos de seguridad de TI desde una perspectiva de red y administración de sistemas. Le ayudará a entender cómo puede cambiar el panorama de infraestructura de TI implementando prácticas óptimas de seguridad específicas e integrando los productos y soluciones Red Hat para contrarrestar las amenazas modernas de ciberseguridad.

Qué aprenderás

● Comprender la seguridad de la infraestructura de TI y sus mejores prácticas

● Implementar infraestructura de nube híbrida

● Realign DevOps en DevSecOps, enfatizando la seguridad

● Implementar la automatización en servicios de infraestructura de TI utilizando Red Hat Ansible

● Explore Red Hat Smart Management, análisis predictivos y auditoría

Quién es este libro

Profesionales de TI manejan la administración de redes/sistemas o la infraestructura de TI de una organización. Los profesionales de DevOps y analistas de ciberseguridad encontrarían el libro útil.

title: Linux® Programming by Example
description:
“This is an excellent introduction to Linux programming. The topics are well chosen and lucidly presented. I learned things myself, especially about internationalization, and I’ve been at this for quite a while.”

—Chet Ramey, Coauthor and Maintainer of the Bash shell

“This is a good introduction to Linux programming. Arnold’s technique of showing how experienced programmers use the Linux programming interfaces is a nice touch, much more useful than the canned programming examples found in most books.”

—Ulrich Drepper, Project Lead, GNU C library

“A gentle yet thorough introduction to the art of UNIX system programming, Linux Programming by Example uses code from a wide range of familiar programs to illustrate each concept it teaches. Readers will enjoy an interesting mix of in-depth API descriptions and portability guidelines, and will come away well prepared to begin reading and writing systems applications. Heartily recommended.”

—Jim Meyering, Coauthor and Maintainer of the GNU Core Utility Programs

Learn Linux® programming, hands-on… from real source code

This book teaches Linux programming in the most effective way possible: by showing and explaining well-written programs. Drawing from both V7 Unix® and current GNU source code, Arnold Robbins focuses on the fundamental system call APIs at the core of any significant program, presenting examples from programs that Linux/Unix users already use every day. Gradually, one step at a time, Robbins teaches both high-level principles and “under the hood” techniques. Along the way, he carefully addresses real-world issues like performance, portability, and robustness. Coverage includes:

Memory management

File I/O

File metadata

Processes

Users and groups

Sorting and searching

Argument parsing

Extended interfaces

Signals

Internationalization

Debugging

And more…

title: Phishing Dark Waters: The Offensive and Defensive Sides of Malicious Emails
description:
An essential anti-phishing desk reference for anyone with an email address

Phishing Dark Waters addresses the growing and continuing scourge of phishing emails, and provides actionable defensive techniques and tools to help you steer clear of malicious emails. Phishing is analyzed from the viewpoint of human decision-making and the impact of deliberate influence and manipulation on the recipient. With expert guidance, this book provides insight into the financial, corporate espionage, nation state, and identity theft goals of the attackers, and teaches you how to spot a spoofed e-mail or cloned website. Included are detailed examples of high profile breaches at Target, RSA, Coca Cola, and the AP, as well as an examination of sample scams including the Nigerian 419, financial themes, and post high-profile event attacks. Learn how to protect yourself and your organization using anti-phishing tools, and how to create your own phish to use as part of a security awareness program.

Phishing is a social engineering technique through email that deceives users into taking an action that is not in their best interest, but usually with the goal of disclosing information or installing malware on the victim's computer. Phishing Dark Waters explains the phishing process and techniques, and the defenses available to keep scammers at bay.

Learn what a phish is, and the deceptive ways they've been used

Understand decision-making, and the sneaky ways phishers reel you in

Recognize different types of phish, and know what to do when you catch one

Use phishing as part of your security awareness program for heightened protection

Attempts to deal with the growing number of phishing incidents include legislation, user training, public awareness, and technical security, but phishing still exploits the natural way humans respond to certain situations. Phishing Dark Waters is an indispensible guide to recognizing and blocking the phish, keeping you, your organization, and your finances safe.

title: Revolution in The Valley [Paperback]
description: There was a time, not too long ago, when the typewriter and notebook ruled, and the computer as an everyday tool was simply a vision. Revolution in the Valley traces this vision back to its earliest roots: the hallways and backrooms of Apple, where the groundbreaking Macintosh computer was born. The book traces the development of the Macintosh, from its inception as an underground skunkworks project in 1979 to its triumphant introduction in 1984 and beyond. The stories in Revolution in the Valley come on extremely good authority. That's because author Andy Hertzfeld was a core member of the team that built the Macintosh system software, and a key creator of the Mac's radically new user interface software. One of the chosen few who worked with the mercurial Steve Jobs, you might call him the ultimate insider. When Revolution in the Valley begins, Hertzfeld is working on Apple's first attempt at a low-cost, consumer-oriented computer: the Apple II. He sees that Steve Jobs is luring some of the company's most brilliant innovators to work on a tiny research effort the Macintosh. Hertzfeld manages to make his way onto the Macintosh research team, and the rest is history. Through lavish illustrations, period photos (many never before published), and Hertzfeld's vivid first-hand accounts, Revolution in the Valley reveals what it was like to be there at the birth of the personal computer revolution. The story comes to life through the book's portrait of the talented and often eccentric characters who made up the Macintosh team. Now, over 20 years later, millions of people are benefiting from the technical achievements of this determined and brilliant group of people.

title: Take Control of Your Digital Storage, 2nd Edition
description:
The Mac user’s guide to mass storage Version 2.3, updated July 7, 2023

This book demystifies storage on the Mac, from mechanical hard drives to solid-state disks, and covering topics such as network-attached storage (NAS), cloud storage, repairing and managing disks, encryption, filesystems (including APFS), and managing data.

As the amount of data we store continues to grow, figuring out where to put it and how to access it becomes more complicated. It’s not just that we need to find space for our increasingly large collections of photos, videos, music, and apps—we want it to be available whenever we need it, and be sure that it’s safe from hackers and thieves.

Every Mac includes internal storage in the form of a hard drive, SSD, or Fusion drive. But you may also have one or more external devices (such as hard drives, flash drives, SD cards, or RAID devices), not to mention network-attached storage (NAS) devices or cloud storage (like Dropbox or iCloud Drive). Making sense of all your options, managing your stored data, choosing new devices or services when you're running out of space, or even just figuring out what's where can drive anyone to distraction.

“Highly recommend Take Control of Your Digital Storage from @TakeControl books! Like all their titles, well-written, super easy to understand, with vital, vital information! I learned a ton and I’m only up to page 30! A must read…I used to teach this subject in workshops at Apple and thought I knew it all! But I still learned so much valuable information.” —Lars Hoel

Fortunately, Jeff Carlson has a book with all the answers! After decades of working with Macs and accumulating massive collections of photos and videos, Jeff has pulled together a wide-ranging book about Mac storage that contains just the help you're looking for. Among many other topics, this book covers:

How to choose a new (internal or external) hard drive, SSD, or hybrid drive
Determining how much storage space you need
What you need to know about APFS, Apple’s new filesystem
How to use APFS snapshots (a.k.a. Time Machine local snapshots)
Formatting and partitioning disks using Disk Utility
How to repair a misbehaving disk
RAIDs: what they are and how different types compare
How to tell when a hard drive is about to fail, and what to do about it
What to do with a hard drive when it has outlived its usefulness
When to use a flash drive or SD card
How to create and use disk images
Deciding among local, network, and cloud storage for various types of files
What a personal cloud is and why you might consider using one
Strategies for freeing up extra disk space

NAS devices get special coverage, including:

Why you might want a NAS
How to choose a NAS—and when it's a better idea than an external hard drive
Using a NAS with your Mac for a wide variety of purposes
Special considerations when using a NAS for digital photos

Jeff also digs into details about numerous storage-related technologies:

How to tell if your third-party SSD needs to have TRIM enabled (and what to do if the answer is yes)
How to create a software RAID using Disk Utility or SoftRAID
What you need to know about filesystems—and how to choose among APFS, Mac OS Extended, FAT, and ExFAT
Why and how to encrypt a disk using FileVault or the Finder
Using iCloud Drive's Optimized Mac Storage feature

If you've ever been stumped at the difference between a volume and a partition, need help figuring out whether to buy a big external hard drive or a NAS for extra storage, or wonder whether Apple's new APFS filesystem is right for your needs, this book will tell you what you need to know.

title: Linux for Small Business Owners: Using Free and Open Source Software to Power Your Dreams
description:
Learn how you can take complete control and run your small business with powerful, free open source software (FOSS). This book introduces small business owners to the power and security of Linux and other FOSS tools to manage any small business as well as the many advantages it has over expensive, proprietary software. While exploring the reasons for using Free Open Source Software, you'll investigate the assertion that, “The value of any software lies in its usefulness not in its price,” set forth by Linux Torvalds, the creator of Linux. 
This book examines the use of Linux and also the other Free Open Source Software you need to meet your business challenges including the usual accounting, Email, web browsing, word-processing tasks. You will be introduced to advanced tools such as those that enable you to create audio and video clips you can use to promote your business or that can even be your primary product, such as how-to instruction.
Most small business owners perform many tasks including that of administering their computers. This book shows you how to find and install new software you need to run your business and keep it up to date using the tools already provided by Linux and the secure, trusted repositories available online. It also explores how to decide which tasks to do in-house and which you might want to sub out to external resources such as advertising and contact services to attract and keep customers. 
Linux for Small Business Owners provides some logic, reason, and explanation for each of the steps that are needed and the tools used to implement Linux in your small business. 
It is a detailed guide to removing Windows from your computers and installing Linux and some commonly used open source software like the LibreOffice suite of programs, accounting, and other software useful to many small businesses. It also provides the information and tools necessary to manage and maintain Linux and applications up-to-date and secure.

What You'll Learn

Understand what the term "free/open source" means and how you can apply it to your business.
Look at the operational and financial advantages of using Free Open Source Software instead of expensive, proprietary software.
See why you will never need to pay for anti-virus and anti-malware software again.
Replace expensive software like Microsoft Office with open source tools such as LibreOffice 
Review the factors required to make an informed decision about switching to Linux.
Install new applications, updates to Linux, and the application software.
Explore why backups are critical, how to create them, and how to use them to restore lost data.

Who This Book Is For

Ideal for small business owners and owner-operated small businesses looking to streamline operations,save money, time and energy managing the common problems associated with using more popular operating systems.

title: Linux in Action
description:
Linux in Action is a task-based tutorial that will give you the skills and deep understanding you need to administer a Linux-based system. This hands-on book guides you through 12 real-world projects so you can practice as you learn. Each chapter ends with a review of best practices, new terms, and exercises.

You can’t learn anything without getting your hands dirty—including Linux. Skills like securing files, folders, and servers, safely installing patches and applications, and managing a network are required for any serious user, including developers, administrators, and DevOps professionals. With this hands-on tutorial, you’ll roll up your sleeves and learn Linux project by project.

About the Book

Linux in Action guides you through 12 real-world projects, including automating a backup-and-restore system, setting up a private Dropbox-style file cloud, and building your own MediaWiki server. You’ll try out interesting examples as you lock in core practices like virtualization, disaster recovery, security, backup, DevOps, and system troubleshooting. Each chapter ends with a review of best practices, new terms, and exercises.

What's Inside

Setting up a safe Linux environment
Managing secure remote connectivity
Building a system recovery device
Patching and upgrading your system
About the Reader

No prior Linux admin experience is required.

David Clinton is a certified Linux Server Professional, seasoned instructor, and author of Manning’s bestselling Learn Amazon Web Services in a Month of Lunches.

Este libro práctico te guía a través de 12 proyectos del mundo real para que puedas practicar mientras aprendes. Cada capítulo termina con un examen de las mejores prácticas, nuevos términos y ejercicios.

Acerca de la tecnología

No puedes aprender nada sin ensuciar tus manos —incluyendo Linux. Habilidades como la obtención de archivos, carpetas y servidores, la instalación segura de parches y aplicaciones, y la gestión de una red son necesarias para cualquier usuario serio, incluyendo desarrolladores, administradores y profesionales DevOps. Con este tutorial práctico, enrollarás tus mangas y aprenderás el proyecto Linux por proyecto.

Acerca del libro

Linux in Action te guía a través de 12 proyectos del mundo real, incluyendo automatizar un sistema de copia de seguridad y restauración, estableciendo una nube de archivos al estilo de Dropbox privada y construyendo tu propio servidor MediaWiki. Prueba ejemplos interesantes a medida que bloquea prácticas básicas como virtualización, recuperación de desastres, seguridad, respaldo, DevOps y solución de problemas del sistema. Cada capítulo termina con un examen de las mejores prácticas, nuevos términos y ejercicios.

Qué hay dentro

Configuración de un entorno Linux seguro
Gestión de conectividad remota segura
Construcción de un dispositivo de recuperación del sistema
Patching y actualizar su sistema
Sobre el lector

No se requiere experiencia previa de administración de Linux.

Sobre el autor

David Clinton es un profesional de Linux Server certificado, instructor experimentado y autor de Manning’s bestselling Learn Amazon Web Services en un mes de Lunches.

CitasUna guía esencial para entender Linux, con muchos ejemplos del mundo real.- Dario Victor Durán, HiQ EstocolmoCuenta una amplia variedad de funciones de Linux que harán que tu vida sea mucho más fácil. Práctica. Jens Christian B. Madsen, IT Relation El programa para la administración del sistema Linux.- Gustavo Patino, Oakland University William Beaumont School of MedicineTodo lo que necesitas para empezar a mantener Linux. No se trata de cómo utilizar Linux, sino de cómo cuidarlo.- Maciej Jurkowski, Grupa Pracuj

title: The Seed: Finding Purpose and Happiness in Life and Work
description:
A business fable to help you discover your purpose in work and life

New from Jon Gordon, the international and Wall Street Journal bestselling author of The Energy Bus, The Seed takes you on a quest for the meaning and passion behind work. Josh, an up-and-comer at his company, is disenchanted with his job. Challenged by his boss to take two weeks to decide if he really wants to work there, Josh takes off for the country, where he meets a wise farmer who gives him a seed and a promise: find the right place to plant the seed, and his purpose will be revealed.

Through Josh's journey cross-country journey, you'll find surprising new sources of wisdom and inspiration in your own business and life.

Nobody captures the deeper meaning of business like Jon Gordon, and The Seed is his most searching and significant book yet. Whatever your profession, take this insightful look at the purpose behind work, and plant The Seed of inspiration in your life!
translatedDescription:
Una fábula de negocio para ayudarle a descubrir su propósito en el trabajo y la vida

Nuevo de Jon Gordon, el internacional y Wall Street Journal bestselling autor de The Energy Bus, The Seed te lleva a una búsqueda por el significado y la pasión detrás del trabajo. Josh, un up-and-comer en su compañía, está desencantado con su trabajo. Desafiado por su jefe para tomar dos semanas para decidir si él realmente quiere trabajar allí, Josh se lleva al país, donde se encuentra con un agricultor sabio que le da una semilla y una promesa: encontrar el lugar adecuado para plantar la semilla, y su propósito será revelado.

A través del viaje de Josh a través del país, encontrará sorprendentes nuevas fuentes de sabiduría e inspiración en su propio negocio y vida.

Nadie capta el significado más profundo de los negocios como Jon Gordon, y The Seed es su libro más buscado y significativo aún. Sea cual sea su profesión, tome esta mirada perspicaz al propósito detrás del trabajo, y plantee la semilla de inspiración en su vida!

title: Practical Linux Infrastructure
description:
Practical Linux Infrastructure teaches you how to use the best open source tools to build a new Linux infrastructure, or alter an existing infrastructure, to ensure it stands up to enterprise-level needs. Each chapter covers a key area of implementation, with clear examples and step-by-step instructions.

Using this book, you’ll understand why scale matters, and what considerations you need to make. You’ll see how to switch to using Google Cloud Platform for your hosted solution, how to use KVM for your virtualization, how to use Git, Postfix, and MySQL for your version control, email, and database, and how to use Puppet for your configuration management. For enterprise-level fault tolerance you’ll use Apache, and for load balancing and high availability, you'll use HAProxy and Keepalived. For trend analysis you’ll learn how to use Cacti, and for notification you’ll use Nagios. You’ll also learn how to utilize BIND to implement DNS, how to use DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol), and how to setup remote access for your infrastructure using VPN and Iptables. You will finish by looking at the various tools you will need to troubleshoot issues that may occur with your hosted infrastructure. This includes how to use CPU, network, disk and memory management tools such as top, netstat, iostat and vmstat.

Author Syed Ali is a senior site reliability engineering manager, who has extensive experience with virtualization and Linux cloud based infrastructure. His previous experience as an entrepreneur in infrastructure computing offers him deep insight into how a business can leverage the power of Linux to their advantage. He brings his expert knowledge to this book to teach others how to perfect their Linux environments. Become a Linux infrastructure pro with Practical Linux Infrastructure today.
translatedDescription:
La infraestructura práctica de Linux te enseña a utilizar las mejores herramientas de código abierto para construir una nueva infraestructura de Linux, o alterar una infraestructura existente, para asegurar que se adapte a las necesidades de nivel empresarial. Cada capítulo abarca una esfera clave de aplicación, con ejemplos claros y instrucciones paso a paso.

Usando este libro, comprenderás por qué importa la escala, y qué consideraciones necesitas hacer. Usted verá cómo cambiar a utilizar Google Cloud Platform para su solución alojada, cómo utilizar KVM para su virtualización, cómo utilizar Git, Postfix y MySQL para su control de versiones, correo electrónico y base de datos, y cómo utilizar Puppet para su gestión de configuración. Para la tolerancia a la falla a nivel de la empresa utilizarás Apache, y para el equilibrio de carga y la alta disponibilidad, usarás HAProxy y Keepalived. Para el análisis de tendencias aprenderás a utilizar Cacti, y para la notificación utilizarás Nagios. También aprenderá cómo utilizar BIND para implementar DNS, cómo utilizar DHCP (Protocolo de Configuración de Host Dinámica), y cómo configurar el acceso remoto para su infraestructura utilizando VPN e Iptables. Usted terminará mirando las diversas herramientas que necesitará para resolver problemas que pueden ocurrir con su infraestructura alojada. Esto incluye cómo utilizar herramientas de CPU, red, disco y gestión de memoria como top, netstat, iostat y vmstat.

Autor Syed Ali es un gerente senior de ingeniería de confiabilidad del sitio, que tiene amplia experiencia con la virtualización y la infraestructura basada en la nube de Linux. Su experiencia anterior como empresario en informática de infraestructura le ofrece una profunda visión de cómo un negocio puede aprovechar el poder de Linux para su ventaja. Lleva su conocimiento experto a este libro para enseñar a otros cómo perfeccionar sus entornos Linux. Conviértete en un profesional de infraestructura Linux con la infraestructura práctica de Linux hoy.

title: The Enterprise Linux Administrator: Journey to a New Linux Career
description:
Learn the basics, followed by the more advanced skills you will need to become an Enterprise Linux administrator. This book will prepare you to use Linux effectively with a clearer understanding of what is needed to successfully leverage new opportunities.

After building a solid Linux knowledge foundation, you will learn how three major community Linux distributions are installed, configured, and used. The book will then guide you through all the different configurations a Linux administrator should know, along with some useful exercises for you to practice. 
Moving on, you will look at Enterprise Linux distributions, and how they are installed and configured. This will be the step that will elevate you from being a Linux administrator to an enterprise Linux administrator. You will also learn how an enterprise Linux administrator configures Linux security, high availability, automation, and large-scale Linux deployments. These skills are required when working in larger Linux estates. Finally, you'll review backups, recovery, and some general troubleshooting.
By the end of this book, you'll not only learn how to become an Enterprise Linux administrator but will also learn what certifications are vital when competing for new career opportunities.

What You'll Learn

Install your own Linux environment
Study the basics to configuring Linux
Become an Enterprise Linux administrator and how to get there
Review comprehensive examples on how to use Linux

Who This Book Is For

Those in the IT industry who have no Linux training or experience who wish to learn how to manage a Linux system
translatedDescription:
Aprende lo básico, seguido por las habilidades más avanzadas que necesitarás para convertirte en administrador de Enterprise Linux. Este libro te preparará para utilizar Linux de manera efectiva con una comprensión más clara de lo que se necesita para aprovechar con éxito nuevas oportunidades.

Después de construir una sólida base de conocimiento Linux, usted aprenderá cómo tres grandes distribuciones comunitarias Linux se instalan, configuran y utilizan. El libro le guiará a través de todas las diferentes configuraciones que un administrador de Linux debe saber, junto con algunos ejercicios útiles para que usted practique.
En movimiento, verá las distribuciones de Enterprise Linux y cómo se instalan y configuran. Este será el paso que le elevará de ser administrador de Linux a un administrador de Linux empresarial. También aprenderá cómo un administrador de Linux configura la seguridad de Linux, alta disponibilidad, automatización y implementaciones Linux a gran escala. Estas habilidades son necesarias al trabajar en propiedades Linux más grandes. Por último, revisará copias de seguridad, recuperación y algunos problemas generales.
Al final de este libro, no solo aprenderás a convertirte en administrador de Enterprise Linux, sino que también aprenderás qué certificaciones son vitales al competir por nuevas oportunidades de carrera.

Lo que aprenderás

Instale su propio entorno Linux
Estudie los fundamentos para configurar Linux
Conviértete en administrador de Enterprise Linux y cómo llegar allí
Revise ejemplos completos sobre cómo utilizar Linux

Quién es este libro

Aquellos en la industria de TI que no tienen ningún entrenamiento o experiencia en Linux que deseen aprender a gestionar un sistema Linux

title: Elliptic Curves, 2nd Edition
description: Like its bestselling predecessor, this second edition develops the theory of elliptic curves to provide a basis for both number theoretic and cryptographic applications. It now includes new chapters on isogenies and hyperelliptic curves, a more complete treatment of the Tate-Lichtenbaum pairing, alternative coordinate systems and related computational issues, and Doud's analytic method for computing torsion on elliptic curves over Q. This edition also discusses how to perform computations with elliptic curves in several popular computer algebra systems. Basic exercises appear at the end of each chapter.
translatedDescription: Al igual que su predecesor bestselling, esta segunda edición desarrolla la teoría de curvas elípticas para proporcionar una base para aplicaciones teóricas y criptográficas de números. Ahora incluye nuevos capítulos sobre isógenas y curvas hiperépticas, un tratamiento más completo del emparejamiento Tate-Lichtenbaum, sistemas de coordenadas alternativos y temas computacionales relacionados, y el método analítico de Doud para computar la torsión en curvas elípticas sobre Q. Esta edición también discute cómo realizar computaciones con curvas elípticas en varios sistemas populares de álgebra computacional. Los ejercicios básicos aparecen al final de cada capítulo.

title: Embedded Linux Projects Using Yocto Project Cookbook
description:
This book, Embedded Linux Projects Using Yocto Project Cookbook, provides over 70 practical recipes for mastering embedded Linux development using the Yocto Project. You will learn how to optimize your development setups, customize root filesystems, and bring professional Yocto-based products to market efficiently and effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to optimize your Yocto Project setup for enhanced development efficiency.
Gain expertise in debugging and optimizing U-Boot and the Linux kernel.
Understand how to create and modify Yocto packages for custom root filesystems.
Master compliance with open source licensing while integrating proprietary components.
Deliver professional embedded systems efficiently, meeting the needs of production environments.

Author(s)

Alex Gonzalez is an experienced embedded systems developer with a deep understanding of the Yocto Project and Linux-based systems. With years of practical experience in developing embedded solutions, Alex shares his expertise through clear, actionable recipes. His approach combines industry best practices with real-world insights to empower readers on their development journeys.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for embedded developers who have a basic understanding of Linux and seek to deepen their knowledge of Linux embedded systems through the Yocto Project. Junior developers looking to improve their Linux skills and create custom Yocto Linux solutions will find it invaluable. Advanced users can benefit from the detailed insights on ARM development and optimization techniques. Whether starting or refining your Yocto expertise, this book has you covered.

Usted aprenderá a optimizar sus configuraciones de desarrollo, personalizar los sistemas de archivos raíz, y traer productos profesionales basados en Yocto para comercializar eficiente y eficazmente.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Aprende a optimizar tu configuración del proyecto Yocto para mejorar la eficiencia del desarrollo.
Obtenga experiencia en depurar y optimizar U-Boot y el kernel de Linux.
Entender cómo crear y modificar paquetes Yocto para sistemas de archivos de raíz personalizados.
Compromiso maestro de licencias de código abierto al tiempo que integra componentes patentados.
Proporcionar sistemas integrados profesionales eficientemente, satisfaciendo las necesidades de entornos de producción.

Autor(s)

Alex Gonzalez es un desarrollador de sistemas integrados experimentado con una profunda comprensión del Proyecto Yocto y sistemas basados en Linux. Con años de experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de soluciones integradas, Alex comparte su experiencia a través de recetas claras y accionables. Su enfoque combina las mejores prácticas de la industria con ideas reales para empoderar a los lectores en sus viajes de desarrollo.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores integrados que tienen una comprensión básica de Linux y buscan profundizar su conocimiento de los sistemas integrados Linux a través del Proyecto Yocto. Los desarrolladores junior que buscan mejorar sus habilidades Linux y crear soluciones personalizadas de Yocto Linux lo encontrarán invaluable. Los usuarios avanzados pueden beneficiarse de las ideas detalladas sobre técnicas de desarrollo y optimización de ARM. Ya sea comenzando o refinando tu experiencia de Yocto, este libro te tiene cubierto.

title: Linux Recipes for Oracle DBAs
description:
Linux Recipes for Oracle DBAs is an example-based book on managing Oracle Database in a Linux environment. Covering commonly used distributions such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Oracle Enterprise Linux, the book is written for database administrators who need to get work done and lack the luxury of curling up fireside with a stack of Linux documentation. The book is task-oriented: Look up the task to perform. See the solution. Read up on the details. Get the job done.

Takes you directly from problem to solution

Covers the "right" mix of Linux user and administration tasks for database administrators

Respects your time by being succinct and to-the-point

Te lleva directamente del problema a la solución

Respeta su tiempo al ser sucinto y al punto

title: DevOps Troubleshooting for Linux Server: Is the Server Down? Tracking Down the Source of Network Problems
description: No matter where you fit in a DevOps organization, network troubleshooting skills are invaluable. It can be difficult to track down networking problems, sometimes because they often impact a system in strange ways. In this digital short,  Kyle Rankin walks you through how to isolate and diagnose a network problem step-by-step by testing problems on different network layers.  He  also lays the groundwork for troubleshooting techniques for specific network services (such as DNS). This digital short is an adapted excerpt from DevOps Troubleshooting: Linux Server Best Practices (isbn 9780321832047) by Kyle Rankin. title: Linux Network Administrator's Guide, 3rd Edition
description:
The Linux Network Administrator's Guide, Third Edition dispenses all the practical advice you need to join a network. Along with some hardware considerations, this highly acclaimed guide takes an in-depth look at all of the essential networking software that comes with the operating system--including basic infrastructure (TCP/IP, wireless networking, firewalling) and the most popular services on Linux systems.But as the follow-up to a classic, the third edition of the Linux Network Administrator's Guide does more than just spruce up the basics. It also provides the very latest information on the following cutting-edge services:

Wireless hubs
OpenLDAP
FreeS/WAN
IMAP
Spam filtering
OpenSSH
BIND
IPv6
Featuring a litany of insider tips and techniques, the Linux Network Administrator's Guide, Third Edition is an invaluable companion for any network administrator interested in integrating Linux into their Windows environmentAuthored by Terry Dawson, Tony Bautts, and Gregor N. Purdy, the Linux Network Administrator's Guide, Third Edition emerged from the Linux Documentation Project (LDP). The LDP's goal is to centralize all of the issues of Linux documentation, ranging from online documentation topics such as installing, using, and running Linux.

title: SELinux by Example: Using Security Enhanced Linux
description:
SELinux: Bring World-Class Security to Any Linux Environment!

SELinux offers Linux/UNIX integrators, administrators, and developers a state-of-the-art platform for building and maintaining highly secure solutions. Now that SELinux is included in the Linux 2.6 kernel—and delivered by default in Fedora Core, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and other major distributions—it’s easier than ever to take advantage of its benefits.

SELinux by Example is the first complete, hands-on guide to using SELinux in production environments. Authored by three leading SELinux researchers and developers, it illuminates every facet of working with SELinux, from its architecture and security object model to its policy language. The book thoroughly explains SELinux sample policies— including the powerful new Reference Policy—showing how to quickly adapt them to your unique environment. It also contains a comprehensive SELinux policy language reference and covers exciting new features in Fedora Core 5 and the upcoming Red Hat Enterprise Linux version 5.

• Thoroughly understand SELinux’s access control and security mechanisms

• Use SELinux to construct secure systems from the ground up

• Gain fine-grained control over kernel resources

• Write policy statements for type enforcement, roles, users, and constraints

• Use optional multilevel security to enforce information classification and manage users with diverse clearances

• Create conditional policies that can be changed on-the-fly

• Define, manage, and maintain SELinux security policies

• Develop and write new SELinux security policy modules

• Leverage emerging SELinux technologies to gain even greater flexibility

• Effectively administer any SELinux system
translatedDescription:
SELinux: ¡Trae seguridad de la clase mundial a cualquier entorno Linux!

SELinux ofrece a los integradores, administradores y desarrolladores de Linux/UNIX una plataforma de vanguardia para construir y mantener soluciones altamente seguras. Ahora que SELinux está incluido en el núcleo Linux 2.6 —y entregado por defecto en Fedora Core, Red Hat Enterprise Linux y otras distribuciones importantes— es más fácil que nunca aprovechar sus beneficios.

SELinux por Ejemplo es la primera guía completa y práctica para utilizar SELinux en entornos de producción. Autorizado por tres investigadores y desarrolladores líderes de SELinux, ilumina cada faceta de trabajar con SELinux, desde su modelo de arquitectura y de seguridad a su lenguaje de política. El libro explica a fondo las políticas de muestra de SELinux, incluyendo la poderosa nueva política de referencia, mostrando cómo adaptarlas rápidamente a su entorno único. También contiene una amplia referencia de lenguaje de política SELinux y cubre nuevas características emocionantes en Fedora Core 5 y la próxima versión Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5.

• Comprender a fondo los mecanismos de control de acceso y seguridad de SELinux

• Use SELinux para construir sistemas seguros desde el suelo

• Obtener control fino sobre los recursos del núcleo

• Escribir declaraciones de política para la aplicación de tipos, roles, usuarios y limitaciones

• Utilizar seguridad multinivel opcional para hacer cumplir la clasificación de información y gestionar usuarios con diversas autorizaciones

• Crear políticas condicionales que puedan cambiarse en la marcha

• Definir, gestionar y mantener políticas de seguridad SELinux

• Desarrollar y escribir nuevos módulos de política de seguridad SELinux

• Aprovechar las tecnologías emergentes de SELinux para ganar aún mayor flexibilidad

• administrar eficazmente cualquier sistema SELinux

title: Computer Structure and Logic
description: Learn about computers and networks from the ground up and take your first step toward certification and your successful computer career! No experience is necessary: Computer Structure and Logic explains every part of your computer, shows how the parts work together, and teaches essential troubleshooting and repair techniques every IT professional needs to know. Learn how information gets into and out of computers (I/O); how your computer’s parts are connected (motherboards and buses); how your computer’s “brain” (CPU) works; all the basics of memory and storage; how your computer starts up and what to do if it doesn’t; how Windows works; how to secure your data, wireless connections, and your computer; and how networks communicate and how to connect to them. Packed with examples and case studies, this book contains more than 150 review questions, with clear explanations of every answer. Test yourself, build your confidence, and launch your career!
translatedDescription: ¡Aprenda sobre ordenadores y redes desde el suelo y tome su primer paso hacia la certificación y su exitosa carrera informática! Ninguna experiencia es necesaria: Estructura de computación y lógica explica cada parte de su computadora, muestra cómo las partes trabajan juntas, y enseña técnicas esenciales de solución de problemas y reparación cada profesional de TI necesita saber. Aprenda cómo la información entra y sale de los ordenadores (I/O); cómo se conectan las partes de su ordenador (motherboards y autobuses); cómo funciona su computadora “brain” (CPU); todos los elementos básicos de la memoria y el almacenamiento; cómo comienza su computadora y qué hacer si no; cómo funciona Windows; cómo asegurar sus datos, conexiones inalámbricas y su computadora; y cómo se comunican las redes y cómo conectarse a ellos. Envasado con ejemplos y estudios de casos, este libro contiene más de 150 preguntas de revisión, con explicaciones claras de cada respuesta. Pruébate, construye tu confianza y lanza tu carrera!

title: Fuzzy Logic with Engineering Applications, 4th Edition
description:
Fuzzy Logic with Engineering Applications, Fourth Edition

Timothy J. Ross, University of New Mexico, USA

 

The latest update on this popular textbook

 

The importance of concepts and methods based on fuzzy logic and fuzzy set theory has been rapidly growing since the early 1990s and all the indications are that this trend will continue in the foreseeable future. Fuzzy Logic with Engineering Applications, Fourth Edition is a new edition of the popular textbook with 15% of new and updated material. Updates have been made to most of the chapters and each chapter now includes new end-of-chapter problems.

 

 

Key features:

New edition of the popular textbook with 15% of new and updated material.
Includes new examples and end-of-chapter problems.
Has been made more concise with the removal of out of date material.
Covers applications of fuzzy logic to engineering and science.
Accompanied by a website hosting a solutions manual and software.

 

 

The book is essential reading for graduates and senior undergraduate students in civil, chemical, mechanical and electrical engineering as wells as researchers and practitioners working with fuzzy logic in industry.

Timothy J. Ross, University of New Mexico, USA

Fuzzy Logic con Aplicaciones de Ingeniería, Cuarta Edición es una nueva edición del popular libro de texto con 15% de material nuevo y actualizado. Cubre aplicaciones de lógica borrosa a ingeniería y ciencia.
Acompañado por un sitio web que alberga un manual de soluciones y software.

title: A Practical Guide to Linux® Commands, Editors, and Shell Programming
description:
Praise for Mark Sobell’s Books

title: Mac OS X For Unix Geeks, 4th Edition
description:
If you're a developer or system administrator lured to Mac OS X because of its Unix roots, you'll quickly discover that performing Unix tasks on a Mac is different than what you're accustomed to. Mac OS X for Unix Geeks serves as a bridge between Apple's Darwin OS and the more traditional Unix systems. This clear, concise guide gives you a tour of Mac OS X's Unix shell in both Leopard and Tiger, and helps you find the facilities that replace or correspond to standard Unix utilities.You'll learn how to perform common Unix tasks in Mac OS X, such as using Directory Services instead of the standard Unix /etc/passwd and /etc/group, and you'll be able to compile code, link to libraries, and port Unix software using either Leopard and Tiger. This book teaches you to:

Navigate the Terminal and understand how it differs from an xterm
Use Open Directory (LDAP) and NetInfo as well as Directory Services
Compile your code with GCC 4
Port Unix programs to Mac OS X with Fink
Use MacPorts to install free/open source software
Search through metadata with Spotlight's command-line utilities
Build the Darwin kernel

And there's much more. Mac OS X for Unix Geeks is the ideal survival guide to tame the Unix side of Leopard and Tiger. If you're a Unix geek with an interest in Mac OS X, you'll soon find that this book is invaluable.

Esta guía clara y concisa le da un recorrido por la concha Unix de Mac OS X en Leopard y Tiger, y le ayuda a encontrar las instalaciones que reemplazan o corresponden a las utilidades estándar Unix. Aprenderás a realizar tareas comunes de Unix en Mac OS X, como el uso de Servicios de Directorio en lugar del estándar Unix /etc/passwd y /etc/group, y podrás compilar código, enlace a bibliotecas, y el software port Unix usando Leopard y Tiger.
